28	def sft_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
29	    pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="pad_mode", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)
30	    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
31	    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
32	
33	    log_prob = model_output["log_probs"]
34	
35	    if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:
36	        # log_prob and loss mask are nested tensors of shape [bsz, j1]
37	        # for each sample, loss mask shape is [1, prompt_length + response_length]
38	        loss_mask = data["loss_mask"]
39	
40	        log_prob_flatten = log_prob.values()
41	        loss_mask_flatten = loss_mask.values()
42	
43	        # left-shift the loss mask by one token to align with log_prob
44	        loss_mask_flatten = torch.roll(loss_mask_flatten, shifts=-1, dims=0)
45	
46	        # NOTE: loss is averaged over all tokens in the batch across all data parallel groups,
47	        # For FSDP backend, the loss is directly used for backward; while for Megatron backend,
48	        # the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` for pp schedule.
49	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob_flatten, loss_mask_flatten) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
50	    else:
51	        response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
52	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob, response_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
53	
54	    return loss, {}
55

57	def ppo_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
58	    """Computes ppo loss from model output (log_prob, entropy, values, etc. ) and old_log_probs from data."""
59	    log_prob = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["log_probs"], data)
60	    entropy = model_output.get("entropy", None)
61	    if entropy is not None:
62	        entropy = no_padding_2_padding(entropy, data)
63	
64	    # global batch info for loss aggregation
65	    config.global_batch_info["dp_size"] = data["dp_size"]
66	    config.global_batch_info["batch_num_tokens"] = data["batch_num_tokens"]
67	    config.global_batch_info["global_batch_size"] = data["global_batch_size"]
68	    config.global_batch_info["loss_scale_factor"] = config.loss_scale_factor
69	
70	    # assumes that if any of the global batch info is set, the policy_loss_fn will
71	    # normalize using dp_size/global_bsz/global_token; in this case, metric aggregation should be SUM
72	    # to reflect the mean loss over the global batch
73	    if (
74	        data["dp_size"] > 1
75	        or data["batch_num_tokens"] is not None
76	        or data["global_batch_size"] is not None
77	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
78	    ):
79	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
80	    else:
81	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN
82	
83	    metrics = {}
84	
85	    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
86	    fields = ["response_mask", "old_log_probs", "advantages"]
87	    if "rollout_is_weights" in data:
88	        fields.append("rollout_is_weights")
89	    if "ref_log_prob" in data:
90	        fields.append("ref_log_prob")
91	    data = data.select(*fields).to_padded_tensor()
92	
93	    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
94	    # compute policy loss
95	    old_log_prob = data["old_log_probs"]
96	    advantages = data["advantages"]
97	    rollout_is_weights = data.get("rollout_is_weights", None)
98	
99	    loss_agg_mode = config.loss_agg_mode
100	
101	    loss_mode = config.policy_loss.get("loss_mode", "vanilla")
102	
103	    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)
104	    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(
105	        old_log_prob=old_log_prob,
106	        log_prob=log_prob,
107	        advantages=advantages,
108	        response_mask=response_mask,
109	        loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode,
110	        config=config,
111	        rollout_is_weights=rollout_is_weights,
112	    )
113	
114	    # AggregationType.MEAN for pg metrics: assumes policy_loss_fn normalizes by local_bsz/local_tokens
115	    # Ex: in compute_policy_loss_vanilla, pg_metrics are pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower
116	    pg_metrics = Metric.from_dict(pg_metrics, aggregation=AggregationType.MEAN)
117	
118	    metrics.update(pg_metrics)
119	    metrics["actor/pg_loss"] = Metric(value=pg_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
120	    policy_loss = pg_loss
121	
122	    # add entropy loss
123	    if entropy is not None:
124	        entropy_loss = agg_loss(
125	            loss_mat=entropy, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
126	        )
127	        entropy_coeff = config.entropy_coeff
128	        policy_loss -= entropy_coeff * entropy_loss
129	        metrics["actor/entropy_loss"] = Metric(value=entropy_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
130	
131	    # add kl loss
132	    if config.use_kl_loss:
133	        ref_log_prob = data["ref_log_prob"]
134	        # compute kl loss
135	        kld = kl_penalty(logprob=log_prob, ref_logprob=ref_log_prob, kl_penalty=config.kl_loss_type)
136	        kl_loss = agg_loss(
137	            loss_mat=kld, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
138	        )
139	
140	        policy_loss += kl_loss * config.kl_loss_coef
141	        metrics["kl_loss"] = Metric(value=kl_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
142	        metrics["kl_coef"] = config.kl_loss_coef
143	
144	    return policy_loss, metrics

147	def value_loss(config: CriticConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
148	    """value loss
149	
150	    Args:
151	        config: CriticConfig
152	        model_output: model output from the model
153	        data: the input to the model
154	        dp_group: data paralle group
155	
156	    Returns:
157	        value loss
158	    """
159	    vpreds = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["values"], data)  # (bsz, response_length)
160	
161	    # Normalize the value loss over the global mini-batch (dp_size / batch_num_tokens /
162	    # global_batch_size) instead of the local micro-batch, so the accumulated critic gradient is
163	    # invariant to how the mini-batch is split into micro-batches (as the actor's ppo_loss does).
164	    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
165	    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
166	    global_batch_size = data["global_batch_size"]
167	
168	    # When the loss is normalized over the global batch, each micro-batch contributes a partial sum,
169	    # so the loss metric must be aggregated with SUM to reflect the global-batch mean.
170	    if (
171	        dp_size > 1
172	        or batch_num_tokens is not None
173	        or global_batch_size is not None
174	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
175	    ):
176	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
177	    else:
178	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN
179	
180	    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
181	    data = data.select("values", "returns", "response_mask").to_padded_tensor()
182	    values = data["values"]
183	    returns = data["returns"]
184	    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
185	
186	    vf_loss, vf_clipfrac = compute_value_loss(
187	        vpreds=vpreds,
188	        values=values,
189	        returns=returns,
190	        response_mask=response_mask,
191	        cliprange_value=config.cliprange_value,
192	        loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode,
193	        dp_size=dp_size,
194	        batch_num_tokens=batch_num_tokens,
195	        global_batch_size=global_batch_size,
196	        loss_scale_factor=config.loss_scale_factor,
197	    )
198	
199	    metrics = {
200	        "critic/vf_loss": Metric(value=vf_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation),
201	        "critic/vf_clipfrac": vf_clipfrac.detach().item(),
202	        "critic/vpred_mean": masked_mean(vpreds, response_mask).detach().item(),
203	    }
204	
205	    return vf_loss, metrics

import torch
from tensordict import TensorDict

from verl.trainer.ppo.core_algos import agg_loss, compute_value_loss, get_policy_loss_fn, kl_penalty
from verl.utils import tensordict_utils as tu
from verl.utils.dataset.dataset_utils import DatasetPadMode
from verl.utils.metric import AggregationType, Metric
from verl.utils.torch_functional import masked_mean, masked_sum
from verl.workers.config import ActorConfig, CriticConfig
from verl.workers.utils.padding import no_padding_2_padding


def sft_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
    pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="pad_mode", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)
    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]

    log_prob = model_output["log_probs"]

    if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:
        # log_prob and loss mask are nested tensors of shape [bsz, j1]
        # for each sample, loss mask shape is [1, prompt_length + response_length]
        loss_mask = data["loss_mask"]

        log_prob_flatten = log_prob.values()
        loss_mask_flatten = loss_mask.values()

        # left-shift the loss mask by one token to align with log_prob
        loss_mask_flatten = torch.roll(loss_mask_flatten, shifts=-1, dims=0)

        # NOTE: loss is averaged over all tokens in the batch across all data parallel groups,
        # For FSDP backend, the loss is directly used for backward; while for Megatron backend,
        # the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` for pp schedule.
        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob_flatten, loss_mask_flatten) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
    else:
        response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob, response_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size

    return loss, {}


def ppo_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
    """Computes ppo loss from model output (log_prob, entropy, values, etc. ) and old_log_probs from data."""
    log_prob = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["log_probs"], data)
    entropy = model_output.get("entropy", None)
    if entropy is not None:
        entropy = no_padding_2_padding(entropy, data)

    # global batch info for loss aggregation
    config.global_batch_info["dp_size"] = data["dp_size"]
    config.global_batch_info["batch_num_tokens"] = data["batch_num_tokens"]
    config.global_batch_info["global_batch_size"] = data["global_batch_size"]
    config.global_batch_info["loss_scale_factor"] = config.loss_scale_factor

    # assumes that if any of the global batch info is set, the policy_loss_fn will
    # normalize using dp_size/global_bsz/global_token; in this case, metric aggregation should be SUM
    # to reflect the mean loss over the global batch
    if (
        data["dp_size"] > 1
        or data["batch_num_tokens"] is not None
        or data["global_batch_size"] is not None
        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
    ):
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
    else:
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN

    metrics = {}

    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
    fields = ["response_mask", "old_log_probs", "advantages"]
    if "rollout_is_weights" in data:
        fields.append("rollout_is_weights")
    if "ref_log_prob" in data:
        fields.append("ref_log_prob")
    data = data.select(*fields).to_padded_tensor()

    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
    # compute policy loss
    old_log_prob = data["old_log_probs"]
    advantages = data["advantages"]
    rollout_is_weights = data.get("rollout_is_weights", None)

    loss_agg_mode = config.loss_agg_mode

    loss_mode = config.policy_loss.get("loss_mode", "vanilla")

    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)
    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(
        old_log_prob=old_log_prob,
        log_prob=log_prob,
        advantages=advantages,
        response_mask=response_mask,
        loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode,
        config=config,
        rollout_is_weights=rollout_is_weights,
    )

    # AggregationType.MEAN for pg metrics: assumes policy_loss_fn normalizes by local_bsz/local_tokens
    # Ex: in compute_policy_loss_vanilla, pg_metrics are pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower
    pg_metrics = Metric.from_dict(pg_metrics, aggregation=AggregationType.MEAN)

    metrics.update(pg_metrics)
    metrics["actor/pg_loss"] = Metric(value=pg_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
    policy_loss = pg_loss

    # add entropy loss
    if entropy is not None:
        entropy_loss = agg_loss(
            loss_mat=entropy, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
        )
        entropy_coeff = config.entropy_coeff
        policy_loss -= entropy_coeff * entropy_loss
        metrics["actor/entropy_loss"] = Metric(value=entropy_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)

    # add kl loss
    if config.use_kl_loss:
        ref_log_prob = data["ref_log_prob"]
        # compute kl loss
        kld = kl_penalty(logprob=log_prob, ref_logprob=ref_log_prob, kl_penalty=config.kl_loss_type)
        kl_loss = agg_loss(
            loss_mat=kld, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
        )

        policy_loss += kl_loss * config.kl_loss_coef
        metrics["kl_loss"] = Metric(value=kl_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
        metrics["kl_coef"] = config.kl_loss_coef

    return policy_loss, metrics


def value_loss(config: CriticConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
    """value loss

    Args:
        config: CriticConfig
        model_output: model output from the model
        data: the input to the model
        dp_group: data paralle group

    Returns:
        value loss
    """
    vpreds = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["values"], data)  # (bsz, response_length)

    # Normalize the value loss over the global mini-batch (dp_size / batch_num_tokens /
    # global_batch_size) instead of the local micro-batch, so the accumulated critic gradient is
    # invariant to how the mini-batch is split into micro-batches (as the actor's ppo_loss does).
    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
    global_batch_size = data["global_batch_size"]

    # When the loss is normalized over the global batch, each micro-batch contributes a partial sum,
    # so the loss metric must be aggregated with SUM to reflect the global-batch mean.
    if (
        dp_size > 1
        or batch_num_tokens is not None
        or global_batch_size is not None
        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
    ):
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
    else:
        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN

    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
    data = data.select("values", "returns", "response_mask").to_padded_tensor()
    values = data["values"]
    returns = data["returns"]
    response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)

    vf_loss, vf_clipfrac = compute_value_loss(
        vpreds=vpreds,
        values=values,
        returns=returns,
        response_mask=response_mask,
        cliprange_value=config.cliprange_value,
        loss_agg_mode=config.loss_agg_mode,
        dp_size=dp_size,
        batch_num_tokens=batch_num_tokens,
        global_batch_size=global_batch_size,
        loss_scale_factor=config.loss_scale_factor,
    )

    metrics = {
        "critic/vf_loss": Metric(value=vf_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation),
        "critic/vf_clipfrac": vf_clipfrac.detach().item(),
        "critic/vpred_mean": masked_mean(vpreds, response_mask).detach().item(),
    }

    return vf_loss, metrics

181	def _convert_to_nested_tensor(v, input_ids_lengths):
182	    """Convert regular tensor to NestedTensor, slicing according to input_ids_lengths.
183	
184	    Args:
185	        v: Tensor to convert, shape [batch, seq_len]
186	        input_ids_lengths: List of valid lengths for each sample
187	
188	    Returns:
189	        Converted NestedTensor
190	    """
191	    if isinstance(v, NestedTensor):
192	        return v
193	
194	    batch_size = v.shape[0]
195	    assert len(input_ids_lengths) == batch_size, (
196	        f"len(input_ids_lengths)={len(input_ids_lengths)} != batch_size={batch_size}"
197	    )
198	
199	    v_split_list = []
200	    for i in range(batch_size):
201	        vi = v[i]
202	        target_len = input_ids_lengths[i]
203	        if vi.shape[0] > target_len:
204	            vi = vi[:target_len]
205	        elif vi.shape[0] < target_len:
206	            vi = torch.cat([vi, torch.ones(target_len - vi.shape[0], dtype=vi.dtype, device=vi.device)])
207	        v_split_list.append(vi)
208	
209	    v = torch.nested.nested_tensor(v_split_list, layout=torch.jagged)
210	    return v

213	def _build_mtp_loss_mask_nested(response_mask, input_ids_lengths, response_attention_mask):
214	    """Build a nested loss_mask aligned to ``input_ids = [prompt; response]`` for MTP.
215	
216	    ``response_mask`` is response-only data. This expands it to full packed
217	    input length as prompt zeros followed by valid response positions.
218	    """
219	    if isinstance(response_mask, NestedTensor):
220	        response_offsets = response_mask.offsets().tolist()
221	        response_lengths = [response_offsets[i + 1] - response_offsets[i] for i in range(len(response_offsets) - 1)]
222	        batch_size = len(response_lengths)
223	        response_values = response_mask.values()
224	    else:
225	        assert response_attention_mask is not None, "response_attention_mask is required to align padded MTP loss_mask"
226	        assert not isinstance(response_attention_mask, NestedTensor), (
227	            "response_attention_mask must be a padded (bs, max_response_len) tensor, got NestedTensor"
228	        )
229	        assert response_attention_mask.shape == response_mask.shape, (
230	            f"response_attention_mask shape {response_attention_mask.shape} "
231	            f"!= response_mask shape {response_mask.shape}"
232	        )
233	        batch_size = response_mask.shape[0]
234	        response_lengths = response_attention_mask.to(torch.int32).sum(dim=-1).tolist()
235	
236	    assert len(input_ids_lengths) == batch_size, (
237	        f"len(input_ids_lengths)={len(input_ids_lengths)} != batch_size={batch_size}"
238	    )
239	
240	    pieces = []
241	    for i in range(batch_size):
242	        actual_total = int(input_ids_lengths[i])
243	        actual_response = int(response_lengths[i])
244	        actual_prompt = actual_total - actual_response
245	        assert actual_prompt >= 0, (
246	            f"sample {i}: actual_response={actual_response} > actual_total={actual_total}; "
247	            "loss_mask cannot be longer than input_ids"
248	        )
249	        prompt_pad = torch.zeros(actual_prompt, dtype=response_mask.dtype, device=response_mask.device)
250	        # Keep the whole valid response span; response_mask may contain internal zeros for tool outputs.
251	        if isinstance(response_mask, NestedTensor):
252	            response_piece = response_values[response_offsets[i] : response_offsets[i + 1]]
253	        else:
254	            response_piece = response_mask[i, :actual_response]
255	        full = torch.cat([prompt_pad, response_piece], dim=0)
256	        assert full.shape[0] == actual_total, (
257	            f"sample {i}: built loss_mask length {full.shape[0]} != input_ids length {actual_total}"
258	        )
259	        pieces.append(full)
260	
261	    return torch.nested.nested_tensor(pieces, layout=torch.jagged)

from typing import Optional

import torch
from torch.nested._internal.nested_tensor import NestedTensor

from verl.utils.megatron_utils import unwrap_model
from verl.workers.config import MtpConfig

from .util import (
    build_vlm_attn_mask_bshd,
    build_vlm_attn_mask_thd,
    postprocess_bshd,
    postprocess_bshd_engine,
    postprocess_packed_seqs,
    postprocess_thd_engine,
    preprocess_bshd,
    preprocess_bshd_engine,
    preprocess_packed_seqs,
    preprocess_thd_engine,
)


def model_forward_gen(vision_model: bool = False):
    def model_forward(
        model,
        input_ids,
        attention_mask,
        position_ids,
        multi_modal_inputs: dict,
        logits_processor=None,
        logits_processor_args: dict = None,
        value_model=False,
        data_format: str = "thd",
        mtp_config: MtpConfig = None,
    ):
        """Forward pass for models with sequence packing."""
        assert data_format in ["thd", "bshd"], "data_format must be 'thd' or 'bshd'"
        pre_process = (
            unwrap_model(model).pre_process if not vision_model else False
        )  # vision model does not need pre_process, because we pack the input_ids to thd in the forward function
        post_process = unwrap_model(model).post_process
        sp = unwrap_model(model).config.sequence_parallel
        fp8 = unwrap_model(model).config.fp8
        use_fp8_padding = fp8 in ["e4m3", "hybrid"]

        model_kwargs = {}
        if "pixel_values" in multi_modal_inputs:
            model_kwargs["pixel_values"] = multi_modal_inputs["pixel_values"].to(input_ids.device)
        if "image_grid_thw" in multi_modal_inputs:
            model_kwargs["image_grid_thw"] = multi_modal_inputs["image_grid_thw"].to(input_ids.device)
        if "pixel_values_videos" in multi_modal_inputs:
            model_kwargs["pixel_values_videos"] = multi_modal_inputs["pixel_values_videos"].to(input_ids.device)
        if "video_grid_thw" in multi_modal_inputs:
            model_kwargs["video_grid_thw"] = multi_modal_inputs["video_grid_thw"].to(input_ids.device)

        batch_size, seq_len = attention_mask.shape[:2]
        mtp_enable_train = mtp_config and mtp_config.enable_train

        if data_format == "thd":
            input_ids_rmpad, packed_seq_params = preprocess_packed_seqs(
                input_ids,
                attention_mask,
                pre_process=pre_process or (post_process and mtp_enable_train),
                use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
            )
            input_ids_rmpad = input_ids_rmpad.contiguous()

            # when pp > 1 and processor is not None, we need to pass the labels and loss_mask to the model
            if mtp_enable_train and post_process:
                args = {
                    k: preprocess_packed_seqs(v, attention_mask, pre_process=True, use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding)[0]
                    for k, v in logits_processor_args.items()
                }
                model_kwargs["labels"] = args["label"].contiguous()
                model_kwargs["loss_mask"] = args["label_mask"].contiguous()

            input_args = dict(
                input_ids=input_ids_rmpad,
                attention_mask=None,
                position_ids=position_ids if not vision_model else None,  # vision models will calculate position_ids
                packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params,
                **model_kwargs,
            )

            if vision_model:
                # workaround for supporting sequence packing with context parallelism
                # cp split with sequence packing will make model lose vision token information, so we need to keep
                # the original input_ids and pack them after vision embedding is calculated,
                # cooporate with mbridge
                input_args["input_ids"] = input_ids
                input_args["attention_mask"] = attention_mask

            output_orig = model(**input_args)

            if post_process and logits_processor is not None:
                args = {
                    k: preprocess_packed_seqs(v, attention_mask, pre_process=True, use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding)[0]
                    for k, v in logits_processor_args.items()
                }
                output_dict = logits_processor(output_orig, **args)
                output = {
                    k: postprocess_packed_seqs(
                        v, packed_seq_params, attention_mask, batch_size, seq_len, post_process=post_process
                    )
                    for k, v in output_dict.items()
                }
            else:
                output = postprocess_packed_seqs(
                    output_orig, packed_seq_params, attention_mask, batch_size, seq_len, post_process=post_process
                )
        elif data_format == "bshd":
            """
            data_format: "thd" or "bshd", default is "thd",
            why we need this?
                for some new models, GPT-OSS, the thd format is not supported, so we need to use the bshd format.
            When using the bshd format, we have to add paddings to the input_ids to meet the longest sequence length, 
            so it is recommended to disable dynamic batch size and set batch size to 1
            """
            assert fp8 is None, "fp8 is not supported for bshd format yet"

            batch_size, sequence_length = attention_mask.shape[:2]
            position_ids_for_preprocess = (
                torch.arange(sequence_length, device=input_ids.device).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, -1)
                if vision_model
                else position_ids
            )
            pre_process_for_bshd = True if vision_model else pre_process
            new_input_ids, new_attention_mask, new_position_ids = preprocess_bshd(
                input_ids,
                attention_mask,
                position_ids_for_preprocess,
                sequence_parallel=sp,
                pre_process=pre_process_for_bshd,
            )
            output_orig = model(
                input_ids=new_input_ids,
                position_ids=None if vision_model else new_position_ids,
                attention_mask=new_attention_mask,
                **model_kwargs,
            )
            if post_process and logits_processor is not None:
                args = {
                    k: preprocess_bshd(
                        v, attention_mask, position_ids_for_preprocess, sequence_parallel=sp, pre_process=True
                    )[0]
                    for k, v in logits_processor_args.items()
                }
                output_dict = logits_processor(output_orig, **args)
                output = {
                    k: postprocess_bshd(
                        v, new_attention_mask, attention_mask, sequence_length, post_process=post_process
                    )
                    for k, v in output_dict.items()
                }
            else:
                output = postprocess_bshd(
                    output_orig, new_attention_mask, attention_mask, sequence_length, post_process=post_process
                )
        if value_model and post_process:
            output = output[..., 0]
        return output

    return model_forward


def _convert_to_nested_tensor(v, input_ids_lengths):
    """Convert regular tensor to NestedTensor, slicing according to input_ids_lengths.

    Args:
        v: Tensor to convert, shape [batch, seq_len]
        input_ids_lengths: List of valid lengths for each sample

    Returns:
        Converted NestedTensor
    """
    if isinstance(v, NestedTensor):
        return v

    batch_size = v.shape[0]
    assert len(input_ids_lengths) == batch_size, (
        f"len(input_ids_lengths)={len(input_ids_lengths)} != batch_size={batch_size}"
    )

    v_split_list = []
    for i in range(batch_size):
        vi = v[i]
        target_len = input_ids_lengths[i]
        if vi.shape[0] > target_len:
            vi = vi[:target_len]
        elif vi.shape[0] < target_len:
            vi = torch.cat([vi, torch.ones(target_len - vi.shape[0], dtype=vi.dtype, device=vi.device)])
        v_split_list.append(vi)

    v = torch.nested.nested_tensor(v_split_list, layout=torch.jagged)
    return v


def _build_mtp_loss_mask_nested(response_mask, input_ids_lengths, response_attention_mask):
    """Build a nested loss_mask aligned to ``input_ids = [prompt; response]`` for MTP.

    ``response_mask`` is response-only data. This expands it to full packed
    input length as prompt zeros followed by valid response positions.
    """
    if isinstance(response_mask, NestedTensor):
        response_offsets = response_mask.offsets().tolist()
        response_lengths = [response_offsets[i + 1] - response_offsets[i] for i in range(len(response_offsets) - 1)]
        batch_size = len(response_lengths)
        response_values = response_mask.values()
    else:
        assert response_attention_mask is not None, "response_attention_mask is required to align padded MTP loss_mask"
        assert not isinstance(response_attention_mask, NestedTensor), (
            "response_attention_mask must be a padded (bs, max_response_len) tensor, got NestedTensor"
        )
        assert response_attention_mask.shape == response_mask.shape, (
            f"response_attention_mask shape {response_attention_mask.shape} "
            f"!= response_mask shape {response_mask.shape}"
        )
        batch_size = response_mask.shape[0]
        response_lengths = response_attention_mask.to(torch.int32).sum(dim=-1).tolist()

    assert len(input_ids_lengths) == batch_size, (
        f"len(input_ids_lengths)={len(input_ids_lengths)} != batch_size={batch_size}"
    )

    pieces = []
    for i in range(batch_size):
        actual_total = int(input_ids_lengths[i])
        actual_response = int(response_lengths[i])
        actual_prompt = actual_total - actual_response
        assert actual_prompt >= 0, (
            f"sample {i}: actual_response={actual_response} > actual_total={actual_total}; "
            "loss_mask cannot be longer than input_ids"
        )
        prompt_pad = torch.zeros(actual_prompt, dtype=response_mask.dtype, device=response_mask.device)
        # Keep the whole valid response span; response_mask may contain internal zeros for tool outputs.
        if isinstance(response_mask, NestedTensor):
            response_piece = response_values[response_offsets[i] : response_offsets[i + 1]]
        else:
            response_piece = response_mask[i, :actual_response]
        full = torch.cat([prompt_pad, response_piece], dim=0)
        assert full.shape[0] == actual_total, (
            f"sample {i}: built loss_mask length {full.shape[0]} != input_ids length {actual_total}"
        )
        pieces.append(full)

    return torch.nested.nested_tensor(pieces, layout=torch.jagged)


def gptmodel_forward_model_engine(
    model,
    input_ids,
    multi_modal_inputs: dict,
    logits_processor=None,
    logits_processor_args: dict = None,
    value_model=False,
    vision_model=False,
    pad_token_id=None,
    data_format: str = "thd",
    mtp_enable_train: bool = False,
    local_cp_size: Optional[int] = None,
    forced_max_seqlen: Optional[int] = None,
    pad_to_length_bucket: Optional[int] = None,
    cp_layout: str = "zigzag",
    router_padding_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    mtp_loss_normalization_factor: float | None = None,
):
    """Default forward pass for GPT models with optional sequence packing."""

    assert data_format in ["thd", "bshd"], "data_format must be 'thd' or 'bshd'"
    pre_process = unwrap_model(model).pre_process
    post_process = unwrap_model(model).post_process

    fp8 = unwrap_model(model).config.fp8
    use_fp8_padding = fp8 in ["e4m3", "hybrid"]

    model_kwargs = {}
    if "pixel_values" in multi_modal_inputs:
        model_kwargs["pixel_values"] = multi_modal_inputs["pixel_values"].to(input_ids.device)
    if "image_grid_thw" in multi_modal_inputs:
        model_kwargs["image_grid_thw"] = multi_modal_inputs["image_grid_thw"].to(input_ids.device)
    if "pixel_values_videos" in multi_modal_inputs:
        model_kwargs["pixel_values_videos"] = multi_modal_inputs["pixel_values_videos"].to(input_ids.device)
    if "video_grid_thw" in multi_modal_inputs:
        model_kwargs["video_grid_thw"] = multi_modal_inputs["video_grid_thw"].to(input_ids.device)

    batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]
    if data_format == "thd":
        input_ids_rmpad, packed_seq_params, position_ids_rmpad = preprocess_thd_engine(
            input_ids,
            pre_process=pre_process or (post_process and mtp_enable_train),
            use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
            local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
            pad_to_length_bucket=pad_to_length_bucket,
            cp_layout=cp_layout,
        )
        if mtp_loss_normalization_factor is not None:
            packed_seq_params._verl_mtp_loss_normalization_factor = mtp_loss_normalization_factor
        input_ids_rmpad = input_ids_rmpad.contiguous()

        args = {}
        if mtp_enable_train and post_process:
            # Use input_ids sequence length to ensure label and loss_mask alignment
            input_ids_offsets = input_ids.offsets()
            input_ids_lengths = input_ids_offsets.diff().tolist()
            response_attention_mask = logits_processor_args.get("response_attention_mask", None)

            for k in ["label", "loss_mask"]:
                v = logits_processor_args[k]
                if k == "loss_mask":
                    v = _build_mtp_loss_mask_nested(v, input_ids_lengths, response_attention_mask)
                else:
                    v = _convert_to_nested_tensor(v, input_ids_lengths)
                logits_processor_args[k] = v
                args[k] = preprocess_thd_engine(
                    v,
                    pre_process=True,
                    need_roll=True,
                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
                    local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
                    pad_to_length_bucket=pad_to_length_bucket,
                    cp_layout=cp_layout,
                )[0]

            model_kwargs["labels"] = args["label"].contiguous()
            model_kwargs["loss_mask"] = args["loss_mask"].contiguous()

        if logits_processor_args and "loss_mask" in logits_processor_args:
            logits_processor_args.pop("loss_mask")
        if logits_processor_args and "response_attention_mask" in logits_processor_args:
            logits_processor_args.pop("response_attention_mask")

        # For VLM model, need to pass bshd format `input_ids` and `attention_mask`.
        attention_mask = None
        if vision_model:
            input_ids_rmpad, attention_mask = build_vlm_attn_mask_thd(input_ids, pad_token_id)

        if router_padding_mask is not None:
            model_kwargs["padding_mask"] = router_padding_mask

        output_orig = model(
            input_ids=input_ids_rmpad,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            position_ids=position_ids_rmpad if mtp_enable_train else None,  # position_ids is only needed for MTP
            packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params,
            **model_kwargs,
        )

        if post_process and logits_processor is not None:
            args = {
                k: preprocess_thd_engine(
                    v,
                    pre_process=True,
                    need_roll=(k == "label"),
                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
                    local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
                    pad_to_length_bucket=pad_to_length_bucket,
                    cp_layout=cp_layout,
                )[0]
                for k, v in logits_processor_args.items()
            }
            output_dict = logits_processor(output_orig, **args)
            output = {
                k: postprocess_thd_engine(
                    v,
                    packed_seq_params,
                    input_ids,
                    batch_size,
                    post_process=post_process,
                    local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
                    cp_layout=cp_layout,
                )
                for k, v in output_dict.items()
            }
        else:
            output = postprocess_thd_engine(
                output_orig,
                packed_seq_params,
                input_ids,
                batch_size,
                post_process=post_process,
                local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
                cp_layout=cp_layout,
            )
    else:
        """
        data_format: "thd" or "bshd", default is "thd",
        why we need this?
            for some new models, GPT-OSS, the thd format is not supported, so we need to use the bshd format.
        When using the bshd format, we have to add paddings to the input_ids to meet the longest sequence length, 
        so it is recommended to disable dynamic batch size and set batch size to 1
        """
        assert local_cp_size is None, "dynamic_CP is not supported for bshd format"

        input_ids_bshd, attention_mask_bshd, position_ids_bshd = preprocess_bshd_engine(
            input_ids,
            pre_process=pre_process or (post_process and mtp_enable_train),
            use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
            forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen,
        )

        if mtp_enable_train and post_process:
            args = {}
            # Use input_ids sequence length to ensure label and loss_mask alignment
            input_ids_offsets = input_ids.offsets()
            input_ids_lengths = input_ids_offsets.diff().tolist()
            response_attention_mask = logits_processor_args.get("response_attention_mask", None)

            for k in ["label", "loss_mask"]:
                v = logits_processor_args[k]
                if k == "loss_mask":
                    v = _build_mtp_loss_mask_nested(v, input_ids_lengths, response_attention_mask)
                else:
                    v = _convert_to_nested_tensor(v, input_ids_lengths)
                logits_processor_args[k] = v
                args[k] = preprocess_bshd_engine(
                    v,
                    pre_process=True,
                    need_roll=True,
                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
                    forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen,
                )[0]
            model_kwargs["labels"] = args["label"].contiguous()
            model_kwargs["loss_mask"] = args["loss_mask"].contiguous()

        if logits_processor_args and "loss_mask" in logits_processor_args:
            logits_processor_args.pop("loss_mask")
        if logits_processor_args and "response_attention_mask" in logits_processor_args:
            logits_processor_args.pop("response_attention_mask")

        # For VLM model, need to pass bshd format `input_ids` and `attention_mask`.
        if vision_model:
            input_ids_bshd, attention_mask = build_vlm_attn_mask_bshd(
                input_ids, batch_size, pad_token_id, forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen
            )
        else:
            attention_mask = attention_mask_bshd

        output_orig = model(
            input_ids=input_ids_bshd,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            position_ids=None if vision_model else position_ids_bshd,
            **model_kwargs,
        )
        if post_process and logits_processor is not None:
            args = {
                k: preprocess_bshd_engine(
                    v,
                    pre_process=True,
                    need_roll=(k == "label"),
                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
                    forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen,
                )[0]
                for k, v in logits_processor_args.items()
            }
            output_dict = logits_processor(output_orig, **args)
            output = {
                k: postprocess_bshd_engine(v, attention_mask_bshd, post_process=post_process)
                for k, v in output_dict.items()
            }
        else:
            output = postprocess_bshd_engine(output_orig, attention_mask_bshd, post_process=post_process)

    if value_model and post_process:
        # output = output[..., 0]
        # while using nested tensor, the advanced indexing operation above will result in an error at backward, i.e.
        # ValueError: NestedTensor _nested_select_backward_default(grad_output: t, self: jt_all, dim: any, index: any)
        # so we use `squeeze` to remove the last dimension
        output = output.squeeze(-1)

    return output

280	    mtp_loss_normalization_factor: float | None = None,
281	):
282	    """Default forward pass for GPT models with optional sequence packing."""
283	
284	    assert data_format in ["thd", "bshd"], "data_format must be 'thd' or 'bshd'"
285	    pre_process = unwrap_model(model).pre_process
286	    post_process = unwrap_model(model).post_process
287	
288	    fp8 = unwrap_model(model).config.fp8
289	    use_fp8_padding = fp8 in ["e4m3", "hybrid"]
290	
291	    model_kwargs = {}
292	    if "pixel_values" in multi_modal_inputs:
293	        model_kwargs["pixel_values"] = multi_modal_inputs["pixel_values"].to(input_ids.device)
294	    if "image_grid_thw" in multi_modal_inputs:
295	        model_kwargs["image_grid_thw"] = multi_modal_inputs["image_grid_thw"].to(input_ids.device)
296	    if "pixel_values_videos" in multi_modal_inputs:
297	        model_kwargs["pixel_values_videos"] = multi_modal_inputs["pixel_values_videos"].to(input_ids.device)
298	    if "video_grid_thw" in multi_modal_inputs:
299	        model_kwargs["video_grid_thw"] = multi_modal_inputs["video_grid_thw"].to(input_ids.device)
300	
301	    batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]
302	    if data_format == "thd":
303	        input_ids_rmpad, packed_seq_params, position_ids_rmpad = preprocess_thd_engine(
304	            input_ids,
305	            pre_process=pre_process or (post_process and mtp_enable_train),
306	            use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
307	            local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
308	            pad_to_length_bucket=pad_to_length_bucket,
309	            cp_layout=cp_layout,
310	        )
311	        if mtp_loss_normalization_factor is not None:
312	            packed_seq_params._verl_mtp_loss_normalization_factor = mtp_loss_normalization_factor
313	        input_ids_rmpad = input_ids_rmpad.contiguous()
314	
315	        args = {}
316	        if mtp_enable_train and post_process:
317	            # Use input_ids sequence length to ensure label and loss_mask alignment
318	            input_ids_offsets = input_ids.offsets()
319	            input_ids_lengths = input_ids_offsets.diff().tolist()
320	            response_attention_mask = logits_processor_args.get("response_attention_mask", None)
321	
322	            for k in ["label", "loss_mask"]:
323	                v = logits_processor_args[k]
324	                if k == "loss_mask":
325	                    v = _build_mtp_loss_mask_nested(v, input_ids_lengths, response_attention_mask)
326	                else:
327	                    v = _convert_to_nested_tensor(v, input_ids_lengths)
328	                logits_processor_args[k] = v
329	                args[k] = preprocess_thd_engine(
330	                    v,
331	                    pre_process=True,
332	                    need_roll=True,
333	                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
334	                    local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
335	                    pad_to_length_bucket=pad_to_length_bucket,
336	                    cp_layout=cp_layout,
337	                )[0]
338	
339	            model_kwargs["labels"] = args["label"].contiguous()
340	            model_kwargs["loss_mask"] = args["loss_mask"].contiguous()
341	
342	        if logits_processor_args and "loss_mask" in logits_processor_args:
343	            logits_processor_args.pop("loss_mask")
344	        if logits_processor_args and "response_attention_mask" in logits_processor_args:
345	            logits_processor_args.pop("response_attention_mask")
346	
347	        # For VLM model, need to pass bshd format `input_ids` and `attention_mask`.
348	        attention_mask = None
349	        if vision_model:
350	            input_ids_rmpad, attention_mask = build_vlm_attn_mask_thd(input_ids, pad_token_id)
351	
352	        if router_padding_mask is not None:
353	            model_kwargs["padding_mask"] = router_padding_mask
354	
355	        output_orig = model(
356	            input_ids=input_ids_rmpad,
357	            attention_mask=attention_mask,
358	            position_ids=position_ids_rmpad if mtp_enable_train else None,  # position_ids is only needed for MTP
359	            packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params,
360	            **model_kwargs,
361	        )
362	
363	        if post_process and logits_processor is not None:
364	            args = {
365	                k: preprocess_thd_engine(
366	                    v,
367	                    pre_process=True,
368	                    need_roll=(k == "label"),
369	                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
370	                    local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
371	                    pad_to_length_bucket=pad_to_length_bucket,
372	                    cp_layout=cp_layout,
373	                )[0]
374	                for k, v in logits_processor_args.items()
375	            }
376	            output_dict = logits_processor(output_orig, **args)
377	            output = {
378	                k: postprocess_thd_engine(
379	                    v,
380	                    packed_seq_params,
381	                    input_ids,
382	                    batch_size,
383	                    post_process=post_process,
384	                    local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
385	                    cp_layout=cp_layout,
386	                )
387	                for k, v in output_dict.items()
388	            }
389	        else:
390	            output = postprocess_thd_engine(
391	                output_orig,
392	                packed_seq_params,
393	                input_ids,
394	                batch_size,
395	                post_process=post_process,
396	                local_cp_size=local_cp_size,
397	                cp_layout=cp_layout,
398	            )
399	    else:
400	        """
401	        data_format: "thd" or "bshd", default is "thd",
402	        why we need this?
403	            for some new models, GPT-OSS, the thd format is not supported, so we need to use the bshd format.
404	        When using the bshd format, we have to add paddings to the input_ids to meet the longest sequence length, 
405	        so it is recommended to disable dynamic batch size and set batch size to 1
406	        """
407	        assert local_cp_size is None, "dynamic_CP is not supported for bshd format"
408	
409	        input_ids_bshd, attention_mask_bshd, position_ids_bshd = preprocess_bshd_engine(
410	            input_ids,
411	            pre_process=pre_process or (post_process and mtp_enable_train),
412	            use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
413	            forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen,
414	        )
415	
416	        if mtp_enable_train and post_process:
417	            args = {}
418	            # Use input_ids sequence length to ensure label and loss_mask alignment
419	            input_ids_offsets = input_ids.offsets()
420	            input_ids_lengths = input_ids_offsets.diff().tolist()
421	            response_attention_mask = logits_processor_args.get("response_attention_mask", None)
422	
423	            for k in ["label", "loss_mask"]:
424	                v = logits_processor_args[k]
425	                if k == "loss_mask":
426	                    v = _build_mtp_loss_mask_nested(v, input_ids_lengths, response_attention_mask)
427	                else:
428	                    v = _convert_to_nested_tensor(v, input_ids_lengths)
429	                logits_processor_args[k] = v
430	                args[k] = preprocess_bshd_engine(
431	                    v,
432	                    pre_process=True,
433	                    need_roll=True,
434	                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
435	                    forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen,
436	                )[0]
437	            model_kwargs["labels"] = args["label"].contiguous()
438	            model_kwargs["loss_mask"] = args["loss_mask"].contiguous()
439	
440	        if logits_processor_args and "loss_mask" in logits_processor_args:
441	            logits_processor_args.pop("loss_mask")
442	        if logits_processor_args and "response_attention_mask" in logits_processor_args:
443	            logits_processor_args.pop("response_attention_mask")
444	
445	        # For VLM model, need to pass bshd format `input_ids` and `attention_mask`.
446	        if vision_model:
447	            input_ids_bshd, attention_mask = build_vlm_attn_mask_bshd(
448	                input_ids, batch_size, pad_token_id, forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen
449	            )
450	        else:
451	            attention_mask = attention_mask_bshd
452	
453	        output_orig = model(
454	            input_ids=input_ids_bshd,
455	            attention_mask=attention_mask,
456	            position_ids=None if vision_model else position_ids_bshd,
457	            **model_kwargs,
458	        )
459	        if post_process and logits_processor is not None:
460	            args = {
461	                k: preprocess_bshd_engine(
462	                    v,
463	                    pre_process=True,
464	                    need_roll=(k == "label"),
465	                    use_fp8_padding=use_fp8_padding,
466	                    forced_max_seqlen=forced_max_seqlen,
467	                )[0]
468	                for k, v in logits_processor_args.items()
469	            }
470	            output_dict = logits_processor(output_orig, **args)
471	            output = {
472	                k: postprocess_bshd_engine(v, attention_mask_bshd, post_process=post_process)
473	                for k, v in output_dict.items()
474	            }
475	        else:
476	            output = postprocess_bshd_engine(output_orig, attention_mask_bshd, post_process=post_process)
477	
478	    if value_model and post_process:
479	        # output = output[..., 0]
480	        # while using nested tensor, the advanced indexing operation above will result in an error at backward, i.e.
481	        # ValueError: NestedTensor _nested_select_backward_default(grad_output: t, self: jt_all, dim: any, index: any)
482	        # so we use `squeeze` to remove the last dimension
483	        output = output.squeeze(-1)
484	
485	    return output

16	import inspect

30	logger = logging.getLogger(__file__)

33	ContextParallelLayout = Literal["zigzag", "contiguous"]
34	
35	# Older Megatron-core releases have no ``cp_partition_mode`` field on PackedSeqParams; they
36	# support only the zigzag CP layout. Inspect ``__init__`` rather than dataclass fields so that
37	# duck-typed replacements (e.g. test stubs taking ``**kwargs``) also count as supporting it.
38	_PACKED_SEQ_PARAMS_INIT_PARAMS = inspect.signature(PackedSeqParams.__init__).parameters
39	_PACKED_SEQ_PARAMS_HAS_CP_PARTITION_MODE = "cp_partition_mode" in _PACKED_SEQ_PARAMS_INIT_PARAMS or any(
40	    p.kind is inspect.Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD for p in _PACKED_SEQ_PARAMS_INIT_PARAMS.values()
41	)

44	def _packed_seq_params_supports(field_name: str) -> bool:
45	    if is_dataclass(PackedSeqParams):
46	        return field_name in {field.name for field in fields(PackedSeqParams)}
47	    return field_name in getattr(PackedSeqParams, "__dataclass_fields__", {})

49	
50	def _compute_fp8_thd_align_size(align_size: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
51	    """Compute FP8 alignment sizes for thd-format sequences.
52	
53	    For FP8 block quantization, each sequence must be padded to a multiple of
54	    lcm(16, align_size), and the total padded length must be divisible by
55	    (align_size * 128) for TransformerEngine compatibility.
56	
57	    Returns (per_seq_align_size, total_align_size).
58	    """
59	    return math.lcm(16, align_size), align_size * 128
60	
61	
62	def preprocess_packed_seqs(
63	    input_ids: torch.Tensor, attention_mask: torch.Tensor, pre_process: bool = True, use_fp8_padding: bool = False
64	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, PackedSeqParams]:
65	    """
66	    Preprocess packed sequences
67	    CP splits sequence into CP*2 chunks, and each GPU gets 2 chunks (GPU0 gets first and last chunks, GPU1
68	    gets second and second last chunks, and so on), this is for load balancing with causal masking.
69	    See https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/issues/1368
70	    """
71	    batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]
72	
73	    seqlens_in_batch = attention_mask.sum(dim=-1, dtype=torch.int32)
74	    tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
75	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
76	    cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
77	    align_size = tp_size * cp_size * 2 if cp_size > 1 else tp_size
78	    if use_fp8_padding:
79	        per_seq_align, total_align = _compute_fp8_thd_align_size(align_size)
80	        align_size = per_seq_align
81	
82	    pad_size = (align_size - seqlens_in_batch % align_size) % align_size
83	    seqlens_in_batch_padded = seqlens_in_batch + pad_size
84	
85	    cu_seqlens = torch.zeros(batch_size + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=input_ids.device)
86	    cu_seqlens[1:] = torch.cumsum(seqlens_in_batch, dim=0)
87	    cu_seqlens_padded = torch.zeros(batch_size + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=input_ids.device)
88	    cu_seqlens_padded[1:] = torch.cumsum(seqlens_in_batch_padded, dim=0)
89	
90	    if use_fp8_padding:
91	        pad_size_last = (total_align - cu_seqlens_padded[-1] % total_align) % total_align
92	        cu_seqlens_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
93	        seqlens_in_batch_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
94	
95	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
96	    # Move the index information needed in the subsequent loop to the CPU at once,
97	    # to avoid frequent .item() calls in the loop that cause D2H synchronization
98	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
99	    seqlens_in_batch_cpu: list[int] = seqlens_in_batch.tolist()  # original valid lengths
100	    seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu: list[int] = seqlens_in_batch_padded.tolist()  # lengths after padding
101	    cu_seqlens_padded_cpu: list[int] = cu_seqlens_padded.tolist()  # start positions (after padding)
102	
103	    # Pure Python int calculation to avoid further synchronization
104	    max_seqlen_in_batch = max(seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu)
105	
106	    shape = list(input_ids.shape[1:])
107	    shape[0] = sum(seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu) // cp_size
108	    if pre_process:
109	        input_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(shape, dtype=input_ids.dtype, device=input_ids.device)
110	        for i in range(batch_size):
111	            # Use Python int, so no GPU→CPU sync in the loop
112	            if cp_size <= 1:
113	                seqlen = seqlens_in_batch_cpu[i]
114	                start_idx = cu_seqlens_padded_cpu[i]
115	                input_ids_rmpad[start_idx : start_idx + seqlen] = input_ids[i, attention_mask[i]]
116	                continue
117	
118	            seqlen_padded_i = seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu[i]
119	            seqlen = seqlen_padded_i // cp_size
120	            half_seqlen = seqlen // 2
121	            start_idx = cu_seqlens_padded_cpu[i] // cp_size
122	            # split to 2 chunks
123	            d = input_ids[i, attention_mask[i]]
124	            first_start = half_seqlen * cp_rank
125	            first_end = min(half_seqlen * (cp_rank + 1), d.shape[0])
126	            first_len = max(first_end - first_start, 0)
127	            if first_len > 0:
128	                input_ids_rmpad[start_idx : start_idx + first_len] = d[first_start:first_end]
129	
130	            remain_start = seqlen_padded_i - half_seqlen * (cp_rank + 1)
131	            remain_end = seqlen_padded_i - half_seqlen * cp_rank
132	            remain_end = min(remain_end, d.shape[0])
133	            remain_len = max(remain_end - remain_start, 0)
134	            if remain_len > 0:
135	                input_ids_rmpad[start_idx + half_seqlen : start_idx + half_seqlen + remain_len] = d[
136	                    remain_start:remain_end
137	                ]
138	
139	    packed_seq_params = PackedSeqParams(
140	        qkv_format="thd",
141	        cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_padded,
142	        max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_in_batch,
143	        cu_seqlens_kv=cu_seqlens_padded,
144	        max_seqlen_kv=max_seqlen_in_batch,
145	        cu_seqlens_q_padded=cu_seqlens_padded,
146	        cu_seqlens_kv_padded=cu_seqlens_padded,
147	    )
148	    if pre_process:
149	        return input_ids_rmpad.unsqueeze(0), packed_seq_params
150	    else:
151	        return input_ids, packed_seq_params
152	
153	
154	def postprocess_packed_seqs(
155	    output: torch.Tensor,
156	    packed_seq_params: PackedSeqParams,
157	    attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
158	    batch_size: int,
159	    seq_len: int,
160	    post_process: bool = True,
161	) -> torch.Tensor:
162	    """
163	    Postprocess packed sequences
164	    """
165	    if not post_process:
166	        return output
167	
168	    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
169	    # Move the lengths and offsets needed for subsequent Python-level indexing to the CPU in advance,
170	    # to avoid a large number of .item() calls in the loop
171	    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
172	    cu_padded_cpu: list[int] = packed_seq_params.cu_seqlens_q_padded.tolist()
173	    seq_lens_cpu: list[int] = attention_mask.sum(dim=1, dtype=torch.int32).cpu().tolist()
174	
175	    shape = [batch_size, seq_len] + list(output.shape[2:])  # 1,packed, dim -> batch_size, seq_len, dim
176	    output_new = torch.zeros(shape, dtype=output.dtype, device=output.device)
177	
178	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
179	    # all gather output across context parallel group
180	    if cp_size > 1:
181	        # output shape: [1, packed_len, hidden_dim]
182	        # need to gather across cp group and concatenate in sequence dimension
183	        output_list = [torch.empty_like(output, dtype=output.dtype) for _ in range(cp_size)]
184	        torch.distributed.all_gather(output_list, output.detach(), group=mpu.get_context_parallel_group())
185	        output_list[mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()] = output
186	    else:
187	        output_list = [output]
188	    for i in range(batch_size):
189	        if cp_size <= 1:
190	            s = seq_lens_cpu[i]
191	            start_idx = cu_padded_cpu[i]
192	            output_new[i, attention_mask[i]] = output[0][start_idx : start_idx + s]
193	            continue
194	        s_len_padded_chunk = (cu_padded_cpu[i + 1] - cu_padded_cpu[i]) // cp_size
195	        half_seqlen = s_len_padded_chunk // 2
196	        s_len = seq_lens_cpu[i]
197	        s_len_padded = s_len_padded_chunk * cp_size
198	        tmp = torch.empty(s_len_padded, *output.shape[2:], device=output.device, dtype=output.dtype)
199	        for j in range(cp_size):
200	            o = output_list[j][0]
201	            # split to 2 chunks
202	            packed_start_idx = cu_padded_cpu[i] // cp_size
203	            o0, o1 = (
204	                o[packed_start_idx : packed_start_idx + half_seqlen],
205	                o[packed_start_idx + half_seqlen : packed_start_idx + s_len_padded_chunk],
206	            )
207	            tmp[j * half_seqlen : (j + 1) * half_seqlen] = o0
208	            tmp[s_len_padded - (j + 1) * half_seqlen : s_len_padded - j * half_seqlen] = o1
209	        output_new[i, attention_mask[i]] = tmp[:s_len]
210	
211	    return output_new
212	
213	
214	def preprocess_bshd(
215	    input_ids: torch.Tensor,
216	    attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
217	    position_ids: torch.Tensor,
218	    sequence_parallel: bool = False,
219	    pre_process: bool = True,
220	):
221	    """
222	    Remove left padding from input_ids, attention_mask and position_ids
223	    return new_input_ids, new_attention_mask, new_position_ids
224	    """
225	    assert attention_mask.ndim == 2
226	    assert position_ids.ndim == 2
227	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
228	    assert cp_size == 1, "Context parallel size without seq_pack is not supported"
229	    batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]
230	    shape = list(input_ids.shape)  # batch_size, seq_len,...
231	    seq_lens = attention_mask.sum(dim=1)
232	    seq_len = seq_lens.max().item()
233	    if sequence_parallel:
234	        sp_world_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
235	        pad_size = (sp_world_size - seq_len % sp_world_size) % sp_world_size
236	        seq_len = seq_len + pad_size
237	    shape[1] = seq_len
238	    if pre_process:
239	        new_input_ids = torch.zeros(dtype=input_ids.dtype, device=input_ids.device, size=shape)
240	    new_attention_mask = torch.zeros(
241	        dtype=attention_mask.dtype, device=attention_mask.device, size=(batch_size, seq_len)
242	    )
243	    new_position_ids = torch.zeros(dtype=position_ids.dtype, device=position_ids.device, size=(batch_size, seq_len))
244	    for i in range(batch_size):
245	        if pre_process:
246	            new_input_ids[i, : seq_lens[i]] = input_ids[i, attention_mask[i]]
247	        new_attention_mask[i, : seq_lens[i]] = attention_mask[i, attention_mask[i]]
248	        new_position_ids[i, : seq_lens[i]] = position_ids[i, attention_mask[i]]
249	    if pre_process:
250	        return new_input_ids, new_attention_mask, new_position_ids
251	    else:
252	        return input_ids, new_attention_mask, new_position_ids
253	
254	
255	def postprocess_bshd(
256	    result,
257	    attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
258	    original_attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
259	    origin_seqlen: int,
260	    post_process: bool = True,
261	):
262	    """
263	    Recover left padding from result
264	    return result
265	    """
266	    if not post_process:
267	        return result
268	    shape = list(result.shape)
269	    batch_size = shape[0]
270	    shape[1] = origin_seqlen
271	    new_result = torch.zeros(dtype=result.dtype, device=result.device, size=shape)
272	    for i in range(batch_size):
273	        new_result[i, original_attention_mask[i]] = result[i, attention_mask[i]]
274	    return new_result
275	
276	
277	def postprocess_packed_seqs_for_dict_output(
278	    labels_mask: torch.Tensor,
279	    output: CausalLMOutputForPPO,
280	    packed_seq_params: PackedSeqParams,
281	    attention_mask: torch.Tensor,
282	    batch_size: int,
283	    seq_len: int,
284	    post_process: bool = True,
285	) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
286	    """_summary_
287	    For fused kernels, the output is a dictionary with keys like 'log_probs', 'entropy', etc.
288	    This function post-processes each tensor in the output dictionary.
289	    Args:
290	        output (CausalLMOutputForPPO): _description_
291	        packed_seq_params (PackedSeqParams): _description_
292	        attention_mask (torch.Tensor): _description_
293	        batch_size (int): _description_
294	        seq_len (int): _description_
295	        post_process (bool, optional): _description_. Defaults to True.
296	    Returns:
297	        CausalLMOutputForPPO: _description_
298	    """
299	    ret = {}
300	    output.entropy = output.entropy.view(1, -1)
301	    output.log_probs = output.log_probs.view(1, -1)
302	    output.log_probs = output.log_probs.masked_fill(~labels_mask, 0.0)
303	    ret["entropy"] = postprocess_packed_seqs(
304	        output.entropy, packed_seq_params, attention_mask, batch_size, seq_len, post_process=post_process
305	    )
306	    ret["log_probs"] = postprocess_packed_seqs(
307	        output.log_probs, packed_seq_params, attention_mask, batch_size, seq_len, post_process=post_process
308	    )
309	    return ret

312	def preprocess_for_mindspeed(input_ids, cu_seqlens_padded, seqlens_in_batch_padded, batch_size):

316	        from mindspeed.core.context_parallel.get_batch_utils import set_actual_seq_len

333	### No padding versions for model engine
334	### inputs are nested tensors
335	def preprocess_thd_engine(
336	    input_ids: torch.Tensor,
337	    pre_process: bool = True,
338	    need_roll: bool = False,
339	    use_fp8_padding: bool = False,
340	    local_cp_size: int | None = None,
341	    min_local_rows: int | None = None,
342	    pad_to_length_bucket: int | None = None,
343	    cp_layout: ContextParallelLayout = "zigzag",
344	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, PackedSeqParams, torch.Tensor | None]:
345	    """Pack nested THD sequences and shard their rows across CP ranks.
346	
347	    ``zigzag`` is the default causal-attention layout: each rank receives a
348	    chunk from both ends of every sequence. ``contiguous`` assigns each rank
349	    one consecutive interval of the *global padded THD buffer*. The latter is
350	    required by attention variants whose CP kernels address rows through one
351	    rank-local ``global_start``.
352	    """
353	    if cp_layout not in ("zigzag", "contiguous"):
354	        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported context parallel layout: {cp_layout}")
355	
356	    batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]
357	
358	    tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
359	    extra_packed_args = {}
360	    if local_cp_size is not None:
361	        # dynamic CP
362	        cp_size = local_cp_size
363	        cp_group = mpu.get_dynamic_data_context_parallel_groups(group_size=local_cp_size)
364	        cp_rank = torch.distributed.get_rank(group=cp_group)
365	        extra_packed_args["local_cp_size"] = local_cp_size
366	        extra_packed_args["cp_group"] = cp_group
367	    else:
368	        cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
369	        cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
370	    if _packed_seq_params_supports("cp_partition_mode"):
371	        extra_packed_args["cp_partition_mode"] = cp_layout
372	    cp_layout_factor = 2 if cp_layout == "zigzag" and cp_size > 1 else 1
373	    align_size = tp_size * cp_size * cp_layout_factor
374	    seqlens_in_batch = input_ids.offsets().diff()
375	
376	    if use_fp8_padding:
377	        per_seq_align, total_align = _compute_fp8_thd_align_size(align_size)
378	        align_size = per_seq_align
379	
380	    pad_size = (align_size - seqlens_in_batch % align_size) % align_size
381	    seqlens_in_batch_padded = seqlens_in_batch + pad_size
382	
383	    cu_seqlens = torch.zeros(batch_size + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=input_ids.device)
384	    cu_seqlens[1:] = torch.cumsum(seqlens_in_batch, dim=0)
385	    cu_seqlens_padded = torch.zeros(batch_size + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=input_ids.device)
386	    cu_seqlens_padded[1:] = torch.cumsum(seqlens_in_batch_padded, dim=0)
387	
388	    preprocess_for_mindspeed(input_ids, cu_seqlens_padded, seqlens_in_batch_padded, batch_size)
389	
390	    if use_fp8_padding:
391	        # Pad the last sequence so total length is divisible by total_align for TE
392	        pad_size_last = (total_align - cu_seqlens_padded[-1] % total_align) % total_align
393	        cu_seqlens_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
394	        seqlens_in_batch_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
395	
396	    if min_local_rows is not None:
397	        min_total_rows = cp_size * min_local_rows
398	        if cu_seqlens_padded[-1] < min_total_rows:
399	            pad_size_last = min_total_rows - cu_seqlens_padded[-1]
400	            cu_seqlens_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
401	            seqlens_in_batch_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
402	
403	    if pad_to_length_bucket is not None:
404	        if pad_to_length_bucket <= 0:
405	            raise ValueError("pad_to_length_bucket must be a positive integer")
406	        total_alignment = math.lcm(pad_to_length_bucket, cp_size)
407	        if use_fp8_padding:
408	            total_alignment = math.lcm(total_alignment, total_align)
409	        pad_size_last = (-cu_seqlens_padded[-1]) % total_alignment
410	        cu_seqlens_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
411	        seqlens_in_batch_padded[-1] += pad_size_last
412	
413	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
414	    # Move the index information needed in the subsequent loop to the CPU at once,
415	    # to avoid frequent .item() calls in the loop that cause D2H synchronization
416	    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
417	    seqlens_in_batch_cpu: list[int] = seqlens_in_batch.tolist()  # original valid lengths
418	    seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu: list[int] = seqlens_in_batch_padded.tolist()  # lengths after padding
419	    cu_seqlens_padded_cpu: list[int] = cu_seqlens_padded.tolist()  # start positions (after padding)
420	
421	    # Pure Python int calculation to avoid further synchronization
422	    max_seqlen_in_batch = max(seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu)
423	
424	    shape = list(input_ids.shape[1:])
425	    shape[0] = sum(seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu) // cp_size
426	    if pre_process:
427	        input_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(shape, dtype=input_ids.dtype, device=input_ids.device)
428	        position_ids_rmpad = torch.zeros(shape[0], dtype=torch.long, device=input_ids.device)
429	        if need_roll:
430	            saved_roll_dict = {}
431	            saved_position_roll_dict = {}
432	        local_global_start = shape[0] * cp_rank
433	        local_global_end = local_global_start + shape[0]
434	        for i in range(batch_size):
435	            # Use Python int, so no GPU→CPU sync in the loop
436	            if cp_layout == "contiguous":
437	                seq_global_start = cu_seqlens_padded_cpu[i]
438	                seq_valid_end = seq_global_start + seqlens_in_batch_cpu[i]
439	                copy_global_start = max(local_global_start, seq_global_start)
440	                copy_global_end = min(local_global_end, seq_valid_end)
441	                if copy_global_start >= copy_global_end:
442	                    continue
443	
444	                source_start = copy_global_start - seq_global_start
445	                source_end = copy_global_end - seq_global_start
446	                destination_start = copy_global_start - local_global_start
447	                destination_end = copy_global_end - local_global_start
448	                d = input_ids[i]
449	                if need_roll:
450	                    source_indices = torch.arange(source_start, source_end, device=d.device)
451	                    source_indices = (source_indices + 1) % seqlens_in_batch_cpu[i]
452	                    input_ids_rmpad[destination_start:destination_end] = torch.index_select(d, 0, source_indices)
453	                    position_ids_rmpad[destination_start:destination_end] = source_indices
454	                else:
455	                    input_ids_rmpad[destination_start:destination_end] = d[source_start:source_end]
456	                    position_ids_rmpad[destination_start:destination_end] = torch.arange(
457	                        source_start, source_end, dtype=torch.long, device=input_ids.device
458	                    )
459	                continue
460	
461	            if cp_size <= 1:
462	                seqlen = seqlens_in_batch_cpu[i]
463	                start_idx = cu_seqlens_padded_cpu[i]
464	                input_ids_rmpad[start_idx : start_idx + seqlen] = input_ids[i]
465	                # Build position_ids: 0, 1, 2, ..., seqlen-1 for this sequence
466	                position_ids_rmpad[start_idx : start_idx + seqlen] = torch.arange(
467	                    seqlen, dtype=torch.long, device=input_ids.device
468	                )
469	                continue
470	
471	            seqlen_padded_i = seqlens_in_batch_padded_cpu[i]
472	            seqlen_orig_i = seqlens_in_batch_cpu[i]
473	            seqlen = seqlen_padded_i // cp_size
474	            half_seqlen = seqlen // 2
475	            start_idx = cu_seqlens_padded_cpu[i] // cp_size
476	            # split to 2 chunks
477	            d = input_ids[i]
478	            # Alignment applies to the sequence dimension. Extra trailing
479	            # dimensions (for example top-k teacher logits) must not affect
480	            # whether a short sequence is padded.
481	            if d.shape[0] < align_size:
482	                original_size = d.shape[0]
483	                pad = torch.zeros((align_size - d.shape[0], *d.shape[1:]), dtype=d.dtype, device=d.device)
484	                d = torch.cat([d, pad], dim=0)
485	                logger.warning_once(
486	                    f"Padding tensor for context parallel alignment, original_size={original_size}, "
487	                    f"align_size={align_size}"
488	                )
489	
490	            input_ids_rmpad[start_idx : start_idx + half_seqlen] = d[
491	                half_seqlen * cp_rank : half_seqlen * (cp_rank + 1)
492	            ]
493	
494	            # Build position_ids for the first chunk
495	            position_ids_rmpad[start_idx : start_idx + half_seqlen] = torch.arange(
496	                half_seqlen * cp_rank, half_seqlen * (cp_rank + 1), dtype=torch.long, device=input_ids.device
497	            )
498	
499	            remain_start = seqlen_padded_i - half_seqlen * (cp_rank + 1)
500	            remain_end = seqlen_padded_i - half_seqlen * cp_rank
501	            remain_end = min(remain_end, d.shape[0])
502	            remain_len = remain_end - remain_start
503	            if remain_len > 0:
504	                input_ids_rmpad[start_idx + half_seqlen : start_idx + half_seqlen + remain_len] = d[
505	                    remain_start:remain_end
506	                ]
507	                # Build position_ids for the remaining chunk: use remain_start as base,
508	                # clamped to original seqlen to avoid exceeding seqlen-1 for padded positions
509	                pos_end = min(remain_end, seqlen_orig_i)
510	                valid_pos_len = pos_end - remain_start
511	                if valid_pos_len > 0:
512	                    position_ids_rmpad[start_idx + half_seqlen : start_idx + half_seqlen + valid_pos_len] = (
513	                        torch.arange(remain_start, pos_end, dtype=torch.long, device=input_ids.device)
514	                    )
515	
516	            if need_roll:
517	                # Handle roll for cp_size > 1 case
518	                saved_roll_dict[start_idx + half_seqlen - 1] = d[(cp_rank + 1) * half_seqlen]
519	                saved_position_roll_dict[start_idx + half_seqlen - 1] = position_ids_rmpad[start_idx + half_seqlen - 1]
520	                if remain_len > 0:
521	                    if remain_end == d.shape[0]:
522	                        saved_roll_dict[start_idx + half_seqlen + remain_len - 1] = d[0]
523	                        saved_position_roll_dict[start_idx + half_seqlen + remain_len - 1] = 0
524	                    else:
525	                        saved_roll_dict[start_idx + half_seqlen + remain_len - 1] = d[remain_end]
526	                        saved_position_roll_dict[start_idx + half_seqlen + remain_len - 1] = position_ids_rmpad[
527	                            start_idx + half_seqlen + remain_len - 1
528	                        ]
529	
530	        if need_roll and cp_layout == "zigzag":
531	            input_ids_rmpad = torch.roll(input_ids_rmpad, shifts=-1, dims=0)
532	            position_ids_rmpad = torch.roll(position_ids_rmpad, shifts=-1, dims=0)
533	            if len(saved_roll_dict) > 0:
534	                for k, v in saved_roll_dict.items():
535	                    input_ids_rmpad[k] = v
536	                for k, v in saved_position_roll_dict.items():
537	                    position_ids_rmpad[k] = v
538	
539	    if _PACKED_SEQ_PARAMS_HAS_CP_PARTITION_MODE:
540	        # Tell the attention kernels how the rows above were sharded across CP ranks. The rows
541	        # are already split according to `cp_layout`, but PackedSeqParams defaults to "zigzag",
542	        # so without this an attention variant that requires a contiguous split (DeepSeek-V4)
543	        # raises "DSv4 THD CP requires a contiguous CP partition." on every forward.
544	        extra_packed_args["cp_partition_mode"] = cp_layout
545	    elif cp_layout != "zigzag" and cp_size > 1:
546	        raise ValueError(
547	            f"cp_layout='{cp_layout}' requires PackedSeqParams.cp_partition_mode, which this "
548	            "Megatron-core version does not provide. Upgrade Megatron-core or use the zigzag layout."
549	        )
550	
551	    packed_seq_params = PackedSeqParams(
552	        qkv_format="thd",
553	        cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_padded,
554	        max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_in_batch,
555	        cu_seqlens_kv=cu_seqlens_padded,
556	        max_seqlen_kv=max_seqlen_in_batch,
557	        cu_seqlens_q_padded=cu_seqlens_padded,
558	        cu_seqlens_kv_padded=cu_seqlens_padded,
559	        **extra_packed_args,
560	    )
561	    if pre_process:
562	        return input_ids_rmpad.unsqueeze(0), packed_seq_params, position_ids_rmpad.unsqueeze(0)
563	    else:
564	        return input_ids, packed_seq_params, None
