332	        assert attention_bias is None, "Attention bias should not be passed into MLA."
333	        assert rotary_pos_cos is None and rotary_pos_sin is None, "MLA does not support Flash Decoding"
334	
335	        # hidden_states: [sq, b, h]
336	
337	        inference_context = deprecate_inference_params(inference_context, inference_params)
338	
339	        # =====================
340	        # Query, Key, and Value
341	        # =====================
342	        # Get the query, key and value tensors based on the type of attention -
343	        # self or cross attn.
344	        # query: [96, 1, 16, 128], key:[96, 1, 16, 128], value:[96, 1, 16, 128]
345	        qkv = self.get_query_key_value_tensors(
346	            hidden_states,
347	            key_value_states,
348	            position_ids,
349	            packed_seq_params,
350	            inference_context=inference_context,
351	        )
352	        query, key, value = qkv[:3]
353	        q_compressed = None
354	        # kv_compressed = None
355	        if len(qkv) > 4:
356	            q_compressed = qkv[3]
357	            # kv_compressed = qkv[4]
358	
359	        # ===================================================
360	        # Adjust key, value for inference
361	        # ===================================================
362	        # rotary_pos_emb = None
363	        if mcore_ge_013:
364	            query, key, value, _, attn_mask_type, _ = self._adjust_key_value_for_inference(
365	                inference_context, query, key, value, rotary_pos_emb=None
366	            )
367	        else:
368	            query, key, value, _, attn_mask_type = self._adjust_key_value_for_inference(
369	                inference_context, query, key, value, rotary_pos_emb=None
370	            )
371	
372	        # TODO: Currently, TE can only accept contiguous tensors for MLA
373	        query = query.contiguous()
374	        key = key.contiguous()
375	        value = value.contiguous()
376	
377	        # ==================================
378	        # core attention computation
379	        # ==================================
380	        # Need corresponding TE change
381	        orig_v_dim = value.shape[-1] if value is not None else None
382	        thd_packed_seq = packed_seq_params is not None and packed_seq_params.qkv_format == "thd"
383	        need_v_pad = (
384	            thd_packed_seq
385	            and getattr(self.config, "experimental_attention_variant", None) is None
386	            and value is not None
387	            and query.shape[-1] != orig_v_dim
388	        )
389	        if need_v_pad:
390	            # Pad V so THD attention can run when Q/V head dims differ.
391	            value = F.pad(value, [0, query.shape[-1] - orig_v_dim])
392	            self.core_attention.hidden_size_per_attention_head_v = value.shape[-1]
393	        if self.checkpoint_core_attention and self.training:
394	            core_attn_out = self._checkpointed_attention_forward(
395	                query, key, value, attention_mask, packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params
396	            )
397	        else:
398	            extra_kwargs = {}
399	            if getattr(self.config, "experimental_attention_variant", None) == "dsa":
400	                # For dsa we need to pass in the original hidden states and the compressed
401	                # query representation.
402	                extra_kwargs["x"] = hidden_states
403	                extra_kwargs["qr"] = q_compressed
404	            core_attn_out = self.core_attention(
405	                query,
406	                key,
407	                value,
408	                attention_mask,
409	                packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params,
410	                attn_mask_type=attn_mask_type,
411	                **extra_kwargs,
412	            )
413	        if thd_packed_seq:
414	            if need_v_pad:
415	                if core_attn_out.ndim == 2:
416	                    core_attn_out = core_attn_out.reshape(*core_attn_out.shape[:-1], -1, value.shape[-1])
417	                core_attn_out = core_attn_out[..., :orig_v_dim]
418	            # reshape to same output shape as unpacked case
419	            # (t, np, hn) -> (t, b=1, h=np*hn)
420	            # t is the pack size = sum (sq_i)
421	            # note that batch is a dummy dimension in the packed case
422	            core_attn_out = core_attn_out.reshape(core_attn_out.size(0), 1, -1)
423	
424	        if self.recompute_up_proj:
425	            assert self.qkv_up_checkpoint is not None
426	            self.qkv_up_checkpoint.discard_output_and_register_recompute(core_attn_out)
427	            self.qkv_up_checkpoint = None
428	
429	        # =================
430	        # Output. [sq, b, h]
431	        # =================
432	        output, bias = self.linear_proj(core_attn_out)
433	
434	        return output, bias
435	
436	    # This patch targets mcore 0.12 MLA behavior only.
437	    # For newer mcore, upstream MLA already has packed-seq + CP handling and
438	    # overriding it with the legacy implementation can break RoPE shapes.
439	    if not mcore_ge_013:
440	        MLASelfAttention.get_query_key_value_tensors = patch_get_query_key_value_tensors
441	
442	    if not mcore_ge_0162:
443	        MultiLatentAttention.forward = patch_forward

476	def apply_patch_megatron_v012_with_torch_v28_v29() -> None:
477	    # Error due to missing serialization_format in _write_item of megatron v012;
478	    # resolved by using megatron v013's implementation.
479	    import inspect
480	    import logging
481	    import os
482	    from pathlib import Path
483	
484	    import megatron.core
485	    import torch
486	    from megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.strategies.async_utils import _disable_gc
487	    from megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.strategies.filesystem_async import _process_memory
488	    from packaging import version
489	    from torch import multiprocessing as mp
490	    from torch.distributed.checkpoint.filesystem import _write_item
491	
492	    if (
493	        version.parse(torch.__version__).base_version not in ("2.8.0", "2.9.0")
494	        or version.parse(megatron.core.__version__).base_version != "0.12.1"
495	    ):
496	        return
497	
498	    WriteBucket = tuple[Path, str, tuple[list, list]]
499	
500	    @staticmethod
501	    @_disable_gc()
502	    def write_preloaded_data_patch(
503	        transform_list,
504	        local_proc_idx: int,
505	        write_bucket: WriteBucket,
506	        results_queue: mp.SimpleQueue,
507	        count_queue: mp.JoinableQueue,
508	        use_fsync: bool,
509	        **kwargs,
510	    ) -> None:
511	        """
512	        Performs actual data saving to storage.
513	
514	        Args:
515	            local_proc_idx (int): index of a local process that performs writing
516	            write_bucket (WriteBucket): data to write to storage
517	            results_queue (mp.Queue): queue to return the write results
518	                to the proxy checkpoint process.
519	            count_queue (mp.JoinableQueue): queue to marks worker task as completed
520	            use_fsync (bool): if True, calls os.fsync at the end of saving
521	
522	        Returns: None, the write result are put into the `queue`
523	        """
524	        logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
525	        logger.debug(f"{local_proc_idx} started")
526	        mem_before = _process_memory()
527	        use_msc = kwargs.get("use_msc", False)
528	        local_results = []
529	        try:
530	            file_name, storage_key, (bytes_data, tensor_data) = write_bucket
531	            extra_kwargs = {}
532	            if "serialization_format" in inspect.signature(_write_item).parameters:
533	                from torch.distributed.checkpoint.filesystem import SerializationFormat
534	
535	                extra_kwargs["serialization_format"] = SerializationFormat.TORCH_SAVE
536	            if use_msc:
537	                import multistorageclient as msc
538	
539	                open_file = msc.open
540	            else:
541	                open_file = open
542	            with open_file(file_name, "wb") as stream:
543	                for write_item, data in bytes_data:
544	                    local_results.append(
545	                        _write_item(*transform_list, stream, data, write_item, storage_key, **extra_kwargs)
546	                    )
547	
548	                for write_item, tensor in tensor_data:
549	                    assert tensor.is_cpu
550	                    local_results.append(
551	                        _write_item(*transform_list, stream, tensor, write_item, storage_key, **extra_kwargs)
552	                    )
553	
554	                if use_fsync:
555	                    if use_msc:
556	                        stream.fsync()
557	                    else:
558	                        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
559	            local_output = (local_proc_idx, local_results)
560	        except Exception as e:
561	            logger.debug(f"{local_proc_idx} failed")
562	            local_output = (local_proc_idx, e)  # type: ignore[assignment]
563	
564	        results_queue.put(local_output)
565	        # Signal this process is done.
566	        count_queue.get()
567	        count_queue.task_done()
568	
569	        mem_after = _process_memory()
570	        logger.debug(f"{local_proc_idx} consumed: {mem_after - mem_before}, before: {mem_before}, after: {mem_after}")
571	
572	    from megatron.core.dist_checkpointing.strategies.filesystem_async import FileSystemWriterAsync
573	
574	    FileSystemWriterAsync.write_preloaded_data = write_preloaded_data_patch

594	# When using checkpoint + MoE models (like Qwen3-30B-A3B and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B),
595	# input tensors and their grads will stay in gpu memory after forward_backward completes.
596	# see https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/3267
597	def apply_patch_megatron_recomputation_backward():
598	    import megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random as rd
599	    import torch
600	
601	    _fork_rng = rd._fork_rng
602	    _set_all_rng_states = rd._set_all_rng_states
603	    detach_variable = rd.detach_variable
604	    gather_split_1d_tensor = rd.gather_split_1d_tensor
605	    safely_set_viewless_tensor_data = rd.safely_set_viewless_tensor_data
606	
607	    @staticmethod
608	    def patch_backward(ctx, *args):
609	        """Backward pass."""
610	        if not torch.autograd._is_checkpoint_valid():
611	            raise RuntimeError("Checkpointing is not compatible with .grad(), please use .backward() if possible")
612	        inputs = ctx.saved_tensors
613	        if ctx.distribute_saved_activations:
614	            safely_set_viewless_tensor_data(inputs[0], gather_split_1d_tensor(inputs[0].data).view(ctx.input_0_shape))
615	
616	        with _fork_rng():
617	            # Set the states to what it used to be before the forward pass.
618	            _set_all_rng_states(*ctx.rng_states)
619	
620	            # Compute the forward pass.
621	            detached_inputs = detach_variable(inputs)
622	
623	            with torch.enable_grad():
624	                outputs = ctx.run_function(*detached_inputs)
625	
626	        if isinstance(outputs, torch.Tensor):
627	            outputs = (outputs,)
628	
629	        # filter out non tensor outputs for backward pass
630	        outputs, args = zip(
631	            *filter(lambda x: torch.is_tensor(x[0]) and x[0].requires_grad, zip(outputs, args, strict=False)),
632	            strict=False,
633	        )
634	        torch.autograd.backward(outputs, args)
635	        # Clone grads to return
636	        grads = tuple(
637	            inp.grad.clone()
638	            if isinstance(inp, torch.Tensor) and inp.grad is not None
639	            else inp.grad
640	            if isinstance(inp, torch.Tensor)
641	            else inp
642	            for inp in detached_inputs
643	        )
644	        cur_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
645	        # Release saved input/grad tensors (MoE residual-memory leak fix, commit 04df110c).
646	        # Skip MTP layer checkpoints: their saved ``hidden_states`` aliases the decoder
647	        # output (a ``torch.chunk`` view), and MTP backward runs before the decoder
648	        # backward, so ``resize_(0)`` would truncate storage the decoder still needs
649	        # -> async CUDA illegal-memory-access.
650	        is_mtp_checkpoint = False
651	        run_fn = getattr(ctx, "run_function", None)
652	        for cell in getattr(run_fn, "__closure__", None) or ():
653	            try:
654	                obj = cell.cell_contents
655	            except ValueError:
656	                continue
657	            if obj.__class__.__name__ == "MultiTokenPredictionLayer":
658	                is_mtp_checkpoint = True
659	                break
660	        if not is_mtp_checkpoint:
661	            for t in detached_inputs:
662	                if isinstance(t, torch.Tensor) and t.requires_grad:
663	                    t.record_stream(cur_stream)
664	                    t.untyped_storage().resize_(0)
665	                    if t.grad is not None:
666	                        t.grad.record_stream(cur_stream)
667	                        t.grad.untyped_storage().resize_(0)
668	        # ctx.saved_tensors = None
669	        return (None, None) + grads
670	
671	    rd.CheckpointFunction.backward = patch_backward

26	def _megatron_calc_layer_map(config):
27	    """Calculate the mapping of global layer_idx to local layer_idx
28	    Returns:
29	        layer_map (Dict: int -> tuple(int, int, int)):
30	            mapping from the global layer index to
31	            a tuple of (pp_rank, virtual_pp_rank, layer_idx inside model)
32	    """
33	    from megatron.core import mpu
34	
35	    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
36	    virtual_pp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1
37	
38	    layer_map = dict()
39	    num_layers_per_model = config.num_hidden_layers // pp_size // virtual_pp_size
40	    assert num_layers_per_model * pp_size * virtual_pp_size == config.num_hidden_layers
41	
42	    for pp_rank_idx in range(pp_size):
43	        for virtual_pp_rank_idx in range(virtual_pp_size):
44	            layer_offset = (
45	                virtual_pp_rank_idx * (config.num_hidden_layers // virtual_pp_size) + pp_rank_idx * num_layers_per_model
46	            )
47	            for layer_idx in range(num_layers_per_model):
48	                layer_map[layer_offset + layer_idx] = (
49	                    pp_rank_idx,
50	                    virtual_pp_rank_idx,
51	                    layer_idx,
52	                )
53	    return layer_map

104	    def _broadcast_tensor(tensor, name) -> torch.Tensor:

139	        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""

import time

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist

from verl.utils.device import get_device_id, get_torch_device

from .saver import _megatron_calc_global_rank


def _megatron_calc_layer_map(config):
    """Calculate the mapping of global layer_idx to local layer_idx
    Returns:
        layer_map (Dict: int -> tuple(int, int, int)):
            mapping from the global layer index to
            a tuple of (pp_rank, virtual_pp_rank, layer_idx inside model)
    """
    from megatron.core import mpu

    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
    virtual_pp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1

    layer_map = dict()
    num_layers_per_model = config.num_hidden_layers // pp_size // virtual_pp_size
    assert num_layers_per_model * pp_size * virtual_pp_size == config.num_hidden_layers

    for pp_rank_idx in range(pp_size):
        for virtual_pp_rank_idx in range(virtual_pp_size):
            layer_offset = (
                virtual_pp_rank_idx * (config.num_hidden_layers // virtual_pp_size) + pp_rank_idx * num_layers_per_model
            )
            for layer_idx in range(num_layers_per_model):
                layer_map[layer_offset + layer_idx] = (
                    pp_rank_idx,
                    virtual_pp_rank_idx,
                    layer_idx,
                )
    return layer_map


def load_state_dict_to_megatron_gptmodel(state_dict, wrapped_models, config, params_dtype, is_value_model=False):
    """Load merged state_dict to sharded Megatron module in training."""
    from megatron.core import DistributedDataParallel as LocalDDP
    from megatron.core import mpu
    from megatron.core.transformer.module import Float16Module
    from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel as torchDDP

    from verl.utils.logger import print_rank_0
    from verl.utils.megatron_utils import unwrap_model

    start_time = time.time()

    def _get_gpt_model(model):
        return model

    def broadcast_params(module):
        for param in module.parameters():
            torch.distributed.broadcast(
                param.data, src=mpu.get_data_parallel_src_rank(), group=mpu.get_data_parallel_group()
            )

    dp_rank = mpu.get_data_parallel_rank()
    pp_rank = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_rank()
    cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
    src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=0, cp_rank=cp_rank)
    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
    virtual_pp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1
    mp_group = mpu.get_model_parallel_group()

    if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
        assert mp_group.rank() == 0, f"mp_rank:[{mp_group.rank}] != 0 on rank #0"
        assert pp_rank == 0, f"pp_rank:[{pp_rank}] != 0 on rank #0"
        assert dp_rank == 0, f"dp_rank:[{dp_rank}] != 0 on rank #0"

    if not isinstance(wrapped_models, list | tuple):
        wrapped_models = list(wrapped_models)

    assert len(wrapped_models) == virtual_pp_size
    num_layers_per_model = config.num_hidden_layers // pp_size // virtual_pp_size
    assert num_layers_per_model * pp_size * virtual_pp_size == config.num_hidden_layers

    models = [None] * len(wrapped_models)

    for i, wrapped_model in enumerate(wrapped_models):
        models[i] = unwrap_model(wrapped_model, (torchDDP, LocalDDP, Float16Module))
        gpt_model_module = _get_gpt_model(models[i])
        assert len(gpt_model_module.decoder.layers) == num_layers_per_model

    def _broadcast_tensor(tensor, name) -> torch.Tensor:
        """broadcast tensor from rank0 across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
            if name in state_dict:
                weight = state_dict[name]
                tensor_shape = weight.shape
            else:
                tensor_shape = None
        else:
            weight = None
            tensor_shape = None

        obj_list = [tensor_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        tensor_shape = obj_list[0]

        if tensor_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tensor:[{name}] not in state_dict, skip load")
            return

        if tensor is None:
            tensor = torch.empty(
                tensor_shape,
                dtype=params_dtype,
                device=get_device_id(),
                requires_grad=False,
            )
        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
            tensor.data.copy_(weight)
        dist.broadcast(tensor, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)

    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_vocab(tensor, name, chunk_dim=0, mutate_func=None) -> torch.Tensor:
        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
            if name in state_dict:
                full_weight = state_dict[name]

                if mutate_func is not None:
                    full_weight = mutate_func(full_weight)
                tensor_chunk = torch.chunk(full_weight, tp_size, dim=chunk_dim)
                chunk_shape = tensor_chunk[0].shape
            else:
                chunk_shape = None
        else:
            chunk_shape = None

        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
        if chunk_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{name}] not in state_dict, skip loading")
            return

        if tensor is None:
            sync_tensor = torch.empty(
                chunk_shape,
                dtype=params_dtype,
                device=get_device_id(),
                requires_grad=False,
            )
        else:
            assert tensor.shape == chunk_shape, (
                f"rank #{torch.distributed.get_rank()} tensor {name} shape {tensor.shape} != {chunk_shape}"
            )
            sync_tensor = torch.empty_like(tensor, device=get_device_id(), requires_grad=False)

        for i in range(tp_size):
            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
                sync_tensor.data.copy_(tensor_chunk[i])
            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
            if (i == tp_rank) and (tensor is not None):
                tensor.data.copy_(sync_tensor)

    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(tensor, name, chunk_dim=0, mutate_func=None) -> torch.Tensor:
        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
            if name in state_dict:
                full_weight = state_dict[name]
                if mutate_func is not None:
                    full_weight = mutate_func(full_weight)
                tensor_chunk = torch.chunk(full_weight, tp_size, dim=chunk_dim)
                chunk_shape = tensor_chunk[0].shape
            else:
                chunk_shape = None
        else:
            chunk_shape = None

        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
        if chunk_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{name}] not in state_dict, skip loading")
            return

        if tensor is None:
            sync_tensor = torch.empty(
                chunk_shape,
                dtype=params_dtype,
                device=get_device_id(),
                requires_grad=False,
            )
        else:
            assert tensor.shape == chunk_shape, (
                f"rank #{torch.distributed.get_rank()} tensor {name} shape {tensor.shape} != {chunk_shape}"
            )
            sync_tensor = torch.empty_like(tensor, device=get_device_id(), requires_grad=False)

        for i in range(tp_size):
            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
                sync_tensor.data.copy_(tensor_chunk[i])
            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
            if (i == tp_rank) and (tensor is not None):
                tensor.data.copy_(sync_tensor)

    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_gate_up(tensor, gate_name, up_name) -> torch.Tensor:
        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
            gate_weight = state_dict[gate_name]
            up_weight = state_dict[up_name]
            new_gate_up_weight = torch.empty(
                config.intermediate_size * 2, config.hidden_size, dtype=params_dtype, device=get_device_id()
            )
            for i in range(tp_size):
                intermediate_size_tp = config.intermediate_size // tp_size
                gate_weight_tp = gate_weight[i * intermediate_size_tp : (i + 1) * intermediate_size_tp]
                up_weight_tp = up_weight[i * intermediate_size_tp : (i + 1) * intermediate_size_tp]
                new_gate_up_weight[intermediate_size_tp * 2 * i : intermediate_size_tp * 2 * (i + 1)].copy_(
                    torch.cat([gate_weight_tp, up_weight_tp], dim=0)
                )

            tensor_chunk = torch.chunk(new_gate_up_weight, tp_size, dim=0)
            chunk_shape = tensor_chunk[0].shape
        else:
            chunk_shape = None

        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
        if chunk_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{gate_name, up_name}] not in state_dict, skip loading")
            return

        if tensor is None:
            sync_tensor = torch.empty(
                chunk_shape,
                dtype=params_dtype,
                device=get_device_id(),
                requires_grad=False,
            )
        else:

        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:

            full_weight_k = state_dict[k_name]
            full_weight_v = state_dict[v_name]

            hidden_size_per_head = getattr(config, "head_dim", config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads)

            if config.num_key_value_heads >= tp_size:
                q_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_attention_heads // tp_size
                kv_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_key_value_heads // tp_size
                total_size = q_size_tp + 2 * kv_size_tp
                sizes = [total_size * tp_size]
                if not bias:
                    sizes.append(config.hidden_size)
                new_weight_qkv = torch.empty(*sizes, dtype=params_dtype, device=get_device_id())
                for i in range(tp_size):
                    q_part = full_weight_q[i * q_size_tp : (i + 1) * q_size_tp]
                    k_part = full_weight_k[i * kv_size_tp : (i + 1) * kv_size_tp]
                    v_part = full_weight_v[i * kv_size_tp : (i + 1) * kv_size_tp]
                    num_query_groups_per_partition = models[0].config.num_query_groups // tp_size
                    new_weight_qkv_this_tp = new_weight_qkv[i * total_size : (i + 1) * total_size]
                    q_part_per_head = torch.chunk(q_part, num_query_groups_per_partition, dim=0)
                    k_part_per_head = torch.chunk(k_part, num_query_groups_per_partition, dim=0)
                    v_part_per_head = torch.chunk(v_part, num_query_groups_per_partition, dim=0)
                    total_size_per_head = total_size // num_query_groups_per_partition
                    for j in range(num_query_groups_per_partition):
                        new_weight_qkv_this_tp[j * total_size_per_head : (j + 1) * total_size_per_head].copy_(
                            torch.cat([q_part_per_head[j], k_part_per_head[j], v_part_per_head[j]], dim=0)
                        )

            else:
                q_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_attention_heads // tp_size
                kv_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head
                total_size = q_size_tp + 2 * kv_size_tp
                sizes = [total_size * tp_size]
                if not bias:
                    sizes.append(config.hidden_size)
                new_weight_qkv = torch.empty(*sizes, dtype=params_dtype, device=get_device_id())
                for i in range(tp_size):
                    q_part = full_weight_q[i * q_size_tp : (i + 1) * q_size_tp]
                    start_idx = i * config.num_key_value_heads // tp_size * hidden_size_per_head
                    end_idx = (i * config.num_key_value_heads // tp_size + 1) * hidden_size_per_head
                    k_part = full_weight_k[start_idx:end_idx]
                    v_part = full_weight_v[start_idx:end_idx]
                    new_weight_qkv_this_tp = new_weight_qkv[i * total_size : (i + 1) * total_size]

                    k_part_per_head = torch.chunk(k_part, config.num_attention_heads, dim=0)
                    v_part_per_head = torch.chunk(v_part, config.num_attention_heads, dim=0)
                    total_size_per_head = total_size // config.num_attention_heads
                    for j in range(config.num_attention_heads):
                        new_weight_qkv_this_tp[j * total_size_per_head : (j + 1) * total_size_per_head].copy_(
                            torch.cat([q_part_per_head[j], k_part_per_head[j], v_part_per_head[j]], dim=0)

        gpt_model_module = _get_gpt_model(models[0])

        if pp_rank == 0:

        # Transformer layers
        # -------------------
        layer_map = _megatron_calc_layer_map(config)

        for layer in range(config.num_hidden_layers):
            layer_name = f"model.layers.{layer}"
            print_rank_0(f"loading layer #{layer}, with layer_name model.layers.{layer}...")
            dst_pp_rank, dst_virtual_pp_rank, dst_layer_idx = layer_map[layer]

            gpt_model_module = _get_gpt_model(models[dst_virtual_pp_rank])
            sync_layer = gpt_model_module.decoder.layers[dst_layer_idx]

            _broadcast_tensor(

            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_qkv(
                sync_layer.self_attention.linear_qkv.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.k_proj.weight",
                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.v_proj.weight",
            )
            if f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_proj.bias" in state_dict:
                _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_qkv(
                    sync_layer.self_attention.linear_qkv.bias if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_proj.bias",
                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.k_proj.bias",
                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.v_proj.bias",
                    bias=True,
                )

            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(
                sync_layer.self_attention.linear_proj.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.o_proj.weight",
                chunk_dim=1,
            )
            _broadcast_tensor(
                sync_layer.mlp.linear_fc1.layer_norm_weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
                f"{layer_name}.post_attention_layernorm.weight",
            )

            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_gate_up(
                sync_layer.mlp.linear_fc1.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
                f"{layer_name}.mlp.gate_proj.weight",
                f"{layer_name}.mlp.up_proj.weight",
            )

            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(
                sync_layer.mlp.linear_fc2.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
                f"{layer_name}.mlp.down_proj.weight",
                chunk_dim=1,
            )
        # Final Layernorm
        # -------------------
        print_rank_0("loading final layernorm...")
        gpt_model_module = _get_gpt_model(models[-1])
        _broadcast_tensor(
            getattr(gpt_model_module.decoder.final_layernorm, "weight", None),
            "model.norm.weight",
        )

        print_rank_0("loading lm_head...")
        lm_head_weight = None
        if pp_rank + 1 == pp_size:
            lm_head_weight = gpt_model_module.output_layer.weight

        if is_value_model:
            # if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
            if "lm_head.weight" in state_dict and state_dict["lm_head.weight"].shape[0] == 1:
                _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "lm_head.weight")
            elif "reward_head.weight" in state_dict and state_dict["reward_head.weight"].shape[0] == 1:
                _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "reward_head.weight")
                print_rank_0("load lm_head from value_head weight")
            elif "score.weight" in state_dict and state_dict["score.weight"].shape[0] == 1:
                _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "score.weight")
                print_rank_0("load lm_head from score weight")
            else:
                _broadcast_tensor(None, "lm_head.weight")
                print_rank_0("fail to match lm_head in value_model")
            # else:

            #     _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "lm_head.weight")

        else:
            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(lm_head_weight, "lm_head.weight")
    dist.barrier()
    # Broadcast weights inside data parallel groups
    for wrapped_model in wrapped_models:
        broadcast_params(wrapped_model)
    pass
    get_torch_device().empty_cache()
    print_rank_0(f"loading megatron ckpt done, time elapsed {time.time() - start_time}s")

292	        tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
293	        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
294	
295	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
296	            assert q_name in state_dict and k_name in state_dict and v_name in state_dict
297	            full_weight_q = state_dict[q_name]
298	            full_weight_k = state_dict[k_name]
299	            full_weight_v = state_dict[v_name]
300	
301	            hidden_size_per_head = getattr(config, "head_dim", config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads)
302	
303	            if config.num_key_value_heads >= tp_size:
304	                q_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_attention_heads // tp_size
305	                kv_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_key_value_heads // tp_size
306	                total_size = q_size_tp + 2 * kv_size_tp
307	                sizes = [total_size * tp_size]
308	                if not bias:
309	                    sizes.append(config.hidden_size)
310	                new_weight_qkv = torch.empty(*sizes, dtype=params_dtype, device=get_device_id())
311	                for i in range(tp_size):
312	                    q_part = full_weight_q[i * q_size_tp : (i + 1) * q_size_tp]
313	                    k_part = full_weight_k[i * kv_size_tp : (i + 1) * kv_size_tp]
314	                    v_part = full_weight_v[i * kv_size_tp : (i + 1) * kv_size_tp]
315	                    num_query_groups_per_partition = models[0].config.num_query_groups // tp_size
316	                    new_weight_qkv_this_tp = new_weight_qkv[i * total_size : (i + 1) * total_size]
317	                    q_part_per_head = torch.chunk(q_part, num_query_groups_per_partition, dim=0)
318	                    k_part_per_head = torch.chunk(k_part, num_query_groups_per_partition, dim=0)
319	                    v_part_per_head = torch.chunk(v_part, num_query_groups_per_partition, dim=0)
320	                    total_size_per_head = total_size // num_query_groups_per_partition
321	                    for j in range(num_query_groups_per_partition):
322	                        new_weight_qkv_this_tp[j * total_size_per_head : (j + 1) * total_size_per_head].copy_(
323	                            torch.cat([q_part_per_head[j], k_part_per_head[j], v_part_per_head[j]], dim=0)
324	                        )
325	
326	            else:
327	                q_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_attention_heads // tp_size
328	                kv_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head
329	                total_size = q_size_tp + 2 * kv_size_tp
330	                sizes = [total_size * tp_size]
331	                if not bias:
332	                    sizes.append(config.hidden_size)
333	                new_weight_qkv = torch.empty(*sizes, dtype=params_dtype, device=get_device_id())
334	                for i in range(tp_size):
335	                    q_part = full_weight_q[i * q_size_tp : (i + 1) * q_size_tp]
336	                    start_idx = i * config.num_key_value_heads // tp_size * hidden_size_per_head
337	                    end_idx = (i * config.num_key_value_heads // tp_size + 1) * hidden_size_per_head
338	                    k_part = full_weight_k[start_idx:end_idx]
339	                    v_part = full_weight_v[start_idx:end_idx]
340	                    new_weight_qkv_this_tp = new_weight_qkv[i * total_size : (i + 1) * total_size]
341	                    q_part_per_head = torch.chunk(q_part, config.num_attention_heads, dim=0)
342	                    k_part_per_head = torch.chunk(k_part, config.num_attention_heads, dim=0)
343	                    v_part_per_head = torch.chunk(v_part, config.num_attention_heads, dim=0)
344	                    total_size_per_head = total_size // config.num_attention_heads
345	                    for j in range(config.num_attention_heads):
346	                        new_weight_qkv_this_tp[j * total_size_per_head : (j + 1) * total_size_per_head].copy_(
347	                            torch.cat([q_part_per_head[j], k_part_per_head[j], v_part_per_head[j]], dim=0)
348	                        )
349	
350	            tensor_chunk = torch.chunk(new_weight_qkv, tp_size, dim=0)
351	            chunk_shape = tensor_chunk[0].shape
352	        else:
353	            chunk_shape = None
354	
355	        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
356	        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
357	        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
358	        if chunk_shape is None:
359	            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
360	            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{q_name, k_name, v_name}] not in state_dict, skip loading")
361	            return
362	
363	        if tensor is None:
364	            sync_tensor = torch.empty(
365	                chunk_shape,
366	                dtype=params_dtype,
367	                device=get_device_id(),
368	                requires_grad=False,
369	            )
370	        else:
371	            assert tensor.shape == chunk_shape, (
372	                f"rank #{torch.distributed.get_rank()} tensor {q_name} shape {tensor.shape} != {chunk_shape}"
373	            )
374	            sync_tensor = torch.empty_like(tensor, device=get_device_id(), requires_grad=False)
375	
376	        for i in range(tp_size):
377	            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
378	                sync_tensor.data.copy_(tensor_chunk[i])
379	            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
380	            if (i == tp_rank) and (tensor is not None):
381	                tensor.data.copy_(sync_tensor)
382	
383	    if dp_rank == 0:
384	        # Embeddings
385	        # -------------------
386	        print_rank_0("loading embeddings...")
387	        gpt_model_module = _get_gpt_model(models[0])
388	        embed_tokens_weight = None
389	        if pp_rank == 0:
390	            embed_tokens_weight = gpt_model_module.embedding.word_embeddings.weight
391	        _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_vocab(embed_tokens_weight, "model.embed_tokens.weight")
392	
393	        # Transformer layers
394	        # -------------------
395	        layer_map = _megatron_calc_layer_map(config)
396	
397	        for layer in range(config.num_hidden_layers):
398	            layer_name = f"model.layers.{layer}"
399	            print_rank_0(f"loading layer #{layer}, with layer_name model.layers.{layer}...")
400	            dst_pp_rank, dst_virtual_pp_rank, dst_layer_idx = layer_map[layer]
401	
402	            gpt_model_module = _get_gpt_model(models[dst_virtual_pp_rank])
403	            sync_layer = gpt_model_module.decoder.layers[dst_layer_idx]
404	
405	            _broadcast_tensor(
406	                sync_layer.self_attention.linear_qkv.layer_norm_weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
407	                f"{layer_name}.input_layernorm.weight",
408	            )
409	
410	            if f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_norm.weight" in state_dict:
411	                _broadcast_tensor(
412	                    sync_layer.self_attention.q_layernorm.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
413	                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_norm.weight",
414	                )
415	                _broadcast_tensor(
416	                    sync_layer.self_attention.k_layernorm.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
417	                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.k_norm.weight",
418	                )
419	
420	            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_qkv(
421	                sync_layer.self_attention.linear_qkv.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
422	                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
423	                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.k_proj.weight",
424	                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.v_proj.weight",
425	            )
426	            if f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_proj.bias" in state_dict:
427	                _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_qkv(
428	                    sync_layer.self_attention.linear_qkv.bias if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
429	                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.q_proj.bias",
430	                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.k_proj.bias",
431	                    f"{layer_name}.self_attn.v_proj.bias",
432	                    bias=True,
433	                )
434	
435	            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(
436	                sync_layer.self_attention.linear_proj.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
437	                f"{layer_name}.self_attn.o_proj.weight",
438	                chunk_dim=1,
439	            )
440	            _broadcast_tensor(
441	                sync_layer.mlp.linear_fc1.layer_norm_weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
442	                f"{layer_name}.post_attention_layernorm.weight",
443	            )
444	
445	            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_gate_up(
446	                sync_layer.mlp.linear_fc1.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
447	                f"{layer_name}.mlp.gate_proj.weight",
448	                f"{layer_name}.mlp.up_proj.weight",
449	            )
450	
451	            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(
452	                sync_layer.mlp.linear_fc2.weight if dst_pp_rank == pp_rank else None,
453	                f"{layer_name}.mlp.down_proj.weight",
454	                chunk_dim=1,
455	            )
456	        # Final Layernorm
457	        # -------------------
458	        print_rank_0("loading final layernorm...")
459	        gpt_model_module = _get_gpt_model(models[-1])
460	        _broadcast_tensor(
461	            getattr(gpt_model_module.decoder.final_layernorm, "weight", None),
462	            "model.norm.weight",
463	        )
464	
465	        print_rank_0("loading lm_head...")
466	        lm_head_weight = None
467	        if pp_rank + 1 == pp_size:
468	            lm_head_weight = gpt_model_module.output_layer.weight
469	
470	        if is_value_model:
471	            # if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
472	            if "lm_head.weight" in state_dict and state_dict["lm_head.weight"].shape[0] == 1:
473	                _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "lm_head.weight")
474	            elif "reward_head.weight" in state_dict and state_dict["reward_head.weight"].shape[0] == 1:
475	                _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "reward_head.weight")
476	                print_rank_0("load lm_head from value_head weight")
477	            elif "score.weight" in state_dict and state_dict["score.weight"].shape[0] == 1:
478	                _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "score.weight")
479	                print_rank_0("load lm_head from score weight")
480	            else:
481	                _broadcast_tensor(None, "lm_head.weight")
482	                print_rank_0("fail to match lm_head in value_model")
483	            # else:
484	
485	            #     _broadcast_tensor(lm_head_weight, "lm_head.weight")
486	
487	        else:
488	            _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(lm_head_weight, "lm_head.weight")
489	    dist.barrier()
490	    # Broadcast weights inside data parallel groups
491	    for wrapped_model in wrapped_models:
492	        broadcast_params(wrapped_model)
493	    pass
494	    get_torch_device().empty_cache()
495	    print_rank_0(f"loading megatron ckpt done, time elapsed {time.time() - start_time}s")

16	import time
17	
18	import torch
19	import torch.distributed as dist

21	from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel as LocalDDP

30	def _megatron_calc_global_rank(
31	    tp_rank: int = 0, dp_rank: int = 0, pp_rank: int = 0, cp_rank: int = 0, ep_rank: int = 0
32	):
33	    """Calculate global rank with support for CP/EP parallelism"""
34	
35	    # Get parallel sizes for each dimension
36	    tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
37	    dp_size = mpu.get_data_parallel_world_size()
38	    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
39	    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
40	    # ep_size = mpu.get_expert_model_parallel_world_size()
41	
42	    # Verify total GPU count matches (must be consistent with parallel_state.py)
43	    total_size = tp_size * dp_size * pp_size * cp_size
44	    assert total_size == torch.distributed.get_world_size(), (
45	        f"{tp_size}x{dp_size}x{pp_size}x{cp_size} != {torch.distributed.get_world_size()}"
46	    )
47	
48	    # Core calculation logic (corresponds to RankGenerator order parameter)
49	    # Assumes default order is "tp-cp-ep-dp-pp"
50	    return ((pp_rank * dp_size + dp_rank) * cp_size + cp_rank) * tp_size + tp_rank
51	
52	
53	def _megatron_calc_layer_map(config):
54	    """Calculate the mapping of global layer_idx to local layer_idx
55	    Returns:
56	        layer_map (Dict: int -> tuple(int, int, int)):
57	            mapping from the global layer index to
58	            a tuple of (pp_rank, virtual_pp_rank, layer_idx inside model)
59	    """
60	    from megatron.core import mpu
61	
62	    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
63	    virtual_pp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1
64	
65	    layer_map = dict()
66	    num_layers_per_model = config.num_hidden_layers // pp_size // virtual_pp_size
67	    assert num_layers_per_model * pp_size * virtual_pp_size == config.num_hidden_layers
68	
69	    for pp_rank_idx in range(pp_size):
70	        for virtual_pp_rank_idx in range(virtual_pp_size):
71	            layer_offset = (
72	                virtual_pp_rank_idx * (config.num_hidden_layers // virtual_pp_size) + pp_rank_idx * num_layers_per_model
73	            )
74	            for layer_idx in range(num_layers_per_model):
75	                layer_map[layer_offset + layer_idx] = (
76	                    pp_rank_idx,
77	                    virtual_pp_rank_idx,
78	                    layer_idx,
79	                )
80	    return layer_map
81	
82	
83	def merge_megatron_ckpt_gptmodel(wrapped_models, config, dtype, is_value_model=False, tie_word_embeddings=False):
84	    """Merge sharded parameters of a Megatron module into a merged checkpoint.
85	
86	    Args:
87	        wrapped_models (list of megatron.core.distributed.DistributedDataParallel):
88	            The local DDP wrapped megatron modules.
89	        config (str or None):
90	            HF config for model
91	        dtype: model params type
92	        is_value_model: if model is value model
93	        tie_word_embeddings: tie_word_embeddings
94	    Returns:
95	        state_dict (dict):
96	            The merged state_dict in rank 0, and an empty dictionary in other ranks.
97	    """
98	    start_time = time.time()
99	
100	    def _get_gpt_model(model):
101	        return model
102	
103	    dp_rank = mpu.get_data_parallel_rank()
104	    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
105	    pp_rank = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_rank()
106	    cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
107	    virtual_pp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1
108	    mp_group = mpu.get_model_parallel_group()
109	
110	    if dist.get_rank() == 0:
111	        assert mp_group.rank() == 0, f"mp_rank:[{mp_group.rank}] != 0 on rank #0"
112	        assert pp_rank == 0, f"pp_rank:[{pp_rank}] != 0 on rank #0"
113	        assert dp_rank == 0, f"dp_rank:[{dp_rank}] != 0 on rank #0"
114	
115	    if not isinstance(wrapped_models, list | tuple):
116	        wrapped_models = list(wrapped_models)
117	
118	    assert len(wrapped_models) == virtual_pp_size
119	    num_layers_per_model = config.num_hidden_layers // pp_size // virtual_pp_size
120	    assert num_layers_per_model * pp_size * virtual_pp_size == config.num_hidden_layers
121	
122	    models = [None] * len(wrapped_models)
123	
124	    for i, wrapped_model in enumerate(wrapped_models):
125	        models[i] = unwrap_model(wrapped_model, (torchDDP, LocalDDP, Float16Module))
126	        assert len(models[i].decoder.layers) == num_layers_per_model, (
127	            "len model layers {} not equal to num_layers_per_model {}".format(
128	                len(models[i].decoder.layers), num_layers_per_model
129	            )
130	        )
131	
132	    state_dict = dict()
133	
134	    def _get_cpu_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor):
135	        if tensor is None:
136	            return None
137	        if tensor.device == torch.device("cpu"):
138	            return tensor.detach().clone()
139	        return tensor.detach().cpu()
140	
141	    def _broadcast_tensor(tensor, name, src_pp_rank) -> torch.Tensor:
142	        """broadcast tensor across mp_group"""
143	        nonlocal state_dict
144	        nonlocal mp_group
145	        src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
146	
147	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
148	            if tensor is None:
149	                weight = None
150	                tensor_shape = None
151	            else:
152	                weight = tensor
153	                tensor_shape = weight.shape
154	        else:
155	            weight = None
156	            tensor_shape = None
157	
158	        obj_list = [tensor_shape]
159	        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
160	        tensor_shape = obj_list[0]
161	
162	        if tensor_shape is None:
163	            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
164	            print_rank_0(f"tensor:[{name}] not exist, skip collect")
165	            return
166	
167	        if weight is None:
168	            weight = torch.empty(
169	                tensor_shape,
170	                dtype=dtype,
171	                device=get_device_id(),
172	                requires_grad=False,
173	            )
174	
175	        dist.broadcast(weight, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
176	
177	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
178	            state_dict[name] = _get_cpu_tensor(weight)
179	
180	    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(tensor, name, src_pp_rank, concat_dim=0, mutate_func=None) -> torch.Tensor:
181	        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
182	        nonlocal state_dict
183	        nonlocal mp_group
184	        # tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
185	        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
186	        src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
187	
188	        chunk_shape = tensor.shape if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank else None
189	
190	        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
191	        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
192	        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
193	        if chunk_shape is None:
194	            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
195	            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{name}] not exist, skip collecting")
196	            return
197	
198	        buffer_tensor = torch.empty(
199	            chunk_shape,
200	            dtype=dtype,
201	            device=get_device_id(),
202	            requires_grad=False,
203	        )
204	
205	        chunk_tensors = [None] * tp_size
206	
207	        for i in range(tp_size):
208	            cur_src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=i, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
209	            sync_tensor = tensor if torch.distributed.get_rank() == cur_src_rank else buffer_tensor
210	            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=cur_src_rank, group=mp_group)
211	
212	            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
213	                chunk_tensors[i] = _get_cpu_tensor(sync_tensor)
214	
215	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
216	            full_tensor = torch.concat(chunk_tensors, dim=concat_dim)
217	            if mutate_func is not None:
218	                full_tensor = mutate_func(full_tensor)
219	            state_dict[name] = full_tensor
220	
221	    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_gate_up(tensor, gate_name, up_name, src_pp_rank) -> torch.Tensor:
222	        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
223	        nonlocal state_dict
224	        nonlocal mp_group
225	        # tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
226	        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
227	        src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
228	
229	        chunk_shape = tensor.shape if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank else None
230	
231	        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
232	        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
233	        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
234	        if chunk_shape is None:
235	            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
236	            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{gate_name, up_name}] not exist, skip collecting")
237	            return
238	
239	        buffer_tensor = torch.empty(
240	            chunk_shape,
241	            dtype=dtype,
242	            device=get_device_id(),
243	            requires_grad=False,
244	        )
245	
246	        chunk_tensors = [None] * tp_size
247	
248	        for i in range(tp_size):
249	            cur_src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=i, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
250	            sync_tensor = tensor if torch.distributed.get_rank() == cur_src_rank else buffer_tensor
251	            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=cur_src_rank, group=mp_group)
252	
253	            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
254	                chunk_tensors[i] = _get_cpu_tensor(sync_tensor)
255	
256	        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
257	            full_tensor = torch.concat(chunk_tensors, dim=0)
258	            intermediate_size_tp = config.intermediate_size // tp_size
259	            gate_weight_list = []
260	            up_weight_list = []
261	            for i in range(tp_size):
262	                gate_up_weight_tp = full_tensor[intermediate_size_tp * 2 * i : intermediate_size_tp * 2 * (i + 1)]
263	                gate_weight_tp = gate_up_weight_tp[:intermediate_size_tp]
264	                up_weight_tp = gate_up_weight_tp[intermediate_size_tp:]
265	                gate_weight_list.append(gate_weight_tp)
266	                up_weight_list.append(up_weight_tp)
267	
268	            state_dict[gate_name] = torch.cat(gate_weight_list, dim=0)

import time

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
from megatron.core import mpu
from megatron.core.distributed import DistributedDataParallel as LocalDDP
from megatron.core.transformer.module import Float16Module
from torch.nn.parallel import DistributedDataParallel as torchDDP

from verl.utils.device import get_device_id, get_torch_device
from verl.utils.logger import print_rank_0
from verl.utils.megatron_utils import unwrap_model


def _megatron_calc_global_rank(
    tp_rank: int = 0, dp_rank: int = 0, pp_rank: int = 0, cp_rank: int = 0, ep_rank: int = 0
):
    """Calculate global rank with support for CP/EP parallelism"""

    # Get parallel sizes for each dimension
    tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
    dp_size = mpu.get_data_parallel_world_size()
    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
    cp_size = mpu.get_context_parallel_world_size()
    # ep_size = mpu.get_expert_model_parallel_world_size()

    # Verify total GPU count matches (must be consistent with parallel_state.py)
    total_size = tp_size * dp_size * pp_size * cp_size
    assert total_size == torch.distributed.get_world_size(), (
        f"{tp_size}x{dp_size}x{pp_size}x{cp_size} != {torch.distributed.get_world_size()}"
    )

    # Core calculation logic (corresponds to RankGenerator order parameter)
    # Assumes default order is "tp-cp-ep-dp-pp"
    return ((pp_rank * dp_size + dp_rank) * cp_size + cp_rank) * tp_size + tp_rank


def _megatron_calc_layer_map(config):
    """Calculate the mapping of global layer_idx to local layer_idx
    Returns:
        layer_map (Dict: int -> tuple(int, int, int)):
            mapping from the global layer index to
            a tuple of (pp_rank, virtual_pp_rank, layer_idx inside model)
    """
    from megatron.core import mpu

    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
    virtual_pp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1

    layer_map = dict()
    num_layers_per_model = config.num_hidden_layers // pp_size // virtual_pp_size
    assert num_layers_per_model * pp_size * virtual_pp_size == config.num_hidden_layers

    for pp_rank_idx in range(pp_size):
        for virtual_pp_rank_idx in range(virtual_pp_size):
            layer_offset = (
                virtual_pp_rank_idx * (config.num_hidden_layers // virtual_pp_size) + pp_rank_idx * num_layers_per_model
            )
            for layer_idx in range(num_layers_per_model):
                layer_map[layer_offset + layer_idx] = (
                    pp_rank_idx,
                    virtual_pp_rank_idx,
                    layer_idx,
                )
    return layer_map


def merge_megatron_ckpt_gptmodel(wrapped_models, config, dtype, is_value_model=False, tie_word_embeddings=False):
    """Merge sharded parameters of a Megatron module into a merged checkpoint.

    Args:
        wrapped_models (list of megatron.core.distributed.DistributedDataParallel):
            The local DDP wrapped megatron modules.
        config (str or None):
            HF config for model
        dtype: model params type
        is_value_model: if model is value model
        tie_word_embeddings: tie_word_embeddings
    Returns:
        state_dict (dict):
            The merged state_dict in rank 0, and an empty dictionary in other ranks.
    """
    start_time = time.time()

    def _get_gpt_model(model):
        return model

    dp_rank = mpu.get_data_parallel_rank()
    pp_size = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size()
    pp_rank = mpu.get_pipeline_model_parallel_rank()
    cp_rank = mpu.get_context_parallel_rank()
    virtual_pp_size = mpu.get_virtual_pipeline_model_parallel_world_size() or 1
    mp_group = mpu.get_model_parallel_group()

    if dist.get_rank() == 0:
        assert mp_group.rank() == 0, f"mp_rank:[{mp_group.rank}] != 0 on rank #0"
        assert pp_rank == 0, f"pp_rank:[{pp_rank}] != 0 on rank #0"
        assert dp_rank == 0, f"dp_rank:[{dp_rank}] != 0 on rank #0"

    if not isinstance(wrapped_models, list | tuple):
        wrapped_models = list(wrapped_models)

    assert len(wrapped_models) == virtual_pp_size
    num_layers_per_model = config.num_hidden_layers // pp_size // virtual_pp_size
    assert num_layers_per_model * pp_size * virtual_pp_size == config.num_hidden_layers

    models = [None] * len(wrapped_models)

    for i, wrapped_model in enumerate(wrapped_models):
        models[i] = unwrap_model(wrapped_model, (torchDDP, LocalDDP, Float16Module))
        assert len(models[i].decoder.layers) == num_layers_per_model, (
            "len model layers {} not equal to num_layers_per_model {}".format(
                len(models[i].decoder.layers), num_layers_per_model
            )
        )

    state_dict = dict()

    def _get_cpu_tensor(tensor: torch.Tensor):
        if tensor is None:
            return None
        if tensor.device == torch.device("cpu"):
            return tensor.detach().clone()
        return tensor.detach().cpu()

    def _broadcast_tensor(tensor, name, src_pp_rank) -> torch.Tensor:
        """broadcast tensor across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank:
            if tensor is None:
                weight = None
                tensor_shape = None
            else:
                weight = tensor
                tensor_shape = weight.shape
        else:
            weight = None
            tensor_shape = None

        obj_list = [tensor_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        tensor_shape = obj_list[0]

        if tensor_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tensor:[{name}] not exist, skip collect")
            return

        if weight is None:
            weight = torch.empty(
                tensor_shape,
                dtype=dtype,
                device=get_device_id(),
                requires_grad=False,
            )

        dist.broadcast(weight, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            state_dict[name] = _get_cpu_tensor(weight)

    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor(tensor, name, src_pp_rank, concat_dim=0, mutate_func=None) -> torch.Tensor:
        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        # tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
        src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)

        chunk_shape = tensor.shape if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank else None

        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
        if chunk_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{name}] not exist, skip collecting")
            return

        buffer_tensor = torch.empty(
            chunk_shape,
            dtype=dtype,
            device=get_device_id(),
            requires_grad=False,
        )

        chunk_tensors = [None] * tp_size

        for i in range(tp_size):
            cur_src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=i, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
            sync_tensor = tensor if torch.distributed.get_rank() == cur_src_rank else buffer_tensor
            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=cur_src_rank, group=mp_group)

            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
                chunk_tensors[i] = _get_cpu_tensor(sync_tensor)

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            full_tensor = torch.concat(chunk_tensors, dim=concat_dim)
            if mutate_func is not None:
                full_tensor = mutate_func(full_tensor)
            state_dict[name] = full_tensor

    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_gate_up(tensor, gate_name, up_name, src_pp_rank) -> torch.Tensor:
        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        # tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
        src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)

        chunk_shape = tensor.shape if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank else None

        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
        if chunk_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{gate_name, up_name}] not exist, skip collecting")
            return

        buffer_tensor = torch.empty(
            chunk_shape,
            dtype=dtype,
            device=get_device_id(),
            requires_grad=False,
        )

        chunk_tensors = [None] * tp_size

        for i in range(tp_size):
            cur_src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=i, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
            sync_tensor = tensor if torch.distributed.get_rank() == cur_src_rank else buffer_tensor
            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=cur_src_rank, group=mp_group)

            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
                chunk_tensors[i] = _get_cpu_tensor(sync_tensor)

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            full_tensor = torch.concat(chunk_tensors, dim=0)
            intermediate_size_tp = config.intermediate_size // tp_size
            gate_weight_list = []
            up_weight_list = []
            for i in range(tp_size):
                gate_up_weight_tp = full_tensor[intermediate_size_tp * 2 * i : intermediate_size_tp * 2 * (i + 1)]
                gate_weight_tp = gate_up_weight_tp[:intermediate_size_tp]
                up_weight_tp = gate_up_weight_tp[intermediate_size_tp:]
                gate_weight_list.append(gate_weight_tp)
                up_weight_list.append(up_weight_tp)

            state_dict[gate_name] = torch.cat(gate_weight_list, dim=0)
            state_dict[up_name] = torch.cat(up_weight_list, dim=0)

    def _broadcast_tp_shard_tensor_qkv(tensor, q_name, k_name, v_name, src_pp_rank):
        """broadcast tensor in tp shards across mp_group"""
        nonlocal state_dict
        nonlocal mp_group
        # tp_rank = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
        tp_size = mpu.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
        src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=0, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)

        chunk_shape = tensor.shape if torch.distributed.get_rank() == src_rank else None

        obj_list = [chunk_shape]
        dist.broadcast_object_list(obj_list, src=src_rank, group=mp_group)
        chunk_shape = obj_list[0]
        if chunk_shape is None:
            # all or none ranks in the mp_group should reach here
            print_rank_0(f"tp_shard tensor:[{q_name}] not exist, skip collecting")
            return

        buffer_tensor = torch.empty(
            chunk_shape,
            dtype=dtype,
            device=get_device_id(),
            requires_grad=False,
        )

        chunk_tensors = [None] * tp_size

        for i in range(tp_size):
            cur_src_rank = _megatron_calc_global_rank(tp_rank=i, dp_rank=0, pp_rank=src_pp_rank, cp_rank=cp_rank)
            sync_tensor = tensor if torch.distributed.get_rank() == cur_src_rank else buffer_tensor
            dist.broadcast(sync_tensor, src=cur_src_rank, group=mp_group)

            if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
                chunk_tensors[i] = _get_cpu_tensor(sync_tensor)

        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
            full_tensor = torch.concat(chunk_tensors, dim=0)
            q_weight_list = []
            k_weight_list = []
            v_weight_list = []
            hidden_size_per_head = getattr(config, "head_dim", config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads)

            if config.num_key_value_heads >= tp_size:
                q_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_attention_heads // tp_size
                kv_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_key_value_heads // tp_size
                total_size = q_size_tp + 2 * kv_size_tp
                for i in range(tp_size):
                    num_query_groups_per_partition = wrapped_models[0].config.num_query_groups // tp_size
                    qkv_part = full_tensor[i * total_size : (i + 1) * total_size]
                    q_size_chunk = q_size_tp // num_query_groups_per_partition
                    kv_size_chunk = kv_size_tp // num_query_groups_per_partition
                    for qkv_part_chunk in qkv_part.chunk(num_query_groups_per_partition):
                        q_part = qkv_part_chunk[:q_size_chunk]
                        k_part = qkv_part_chunk[q_size_chunk : q_size_chunk + kv_size_chunk]
                        v_part = qkv_part_chunk[q_size_chunk + kv_size_chunk :]
                        q_weight_list.append(q_part)
                        k_weight_list.append(k_part)
                        v_weight_list.append(v_part)
            else:
                q_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head * config.num_attention_heads // tp_size
                kv_size_tp = hidden_size_per_head
                total_size = q_size_tp + 2 * kv_size_tp
                for i in range(tp_size):
                    num_query_groups_per_partition = wrapped_models[0].config.num_query_groups // tp_size
                    qkv_part = full_tensor[i * total_size : (i + 1) * total_size]
                    q_size_chunk = q_size_tp // num_query_groups_per_partition
                    kv_size_chunk = kv_size_tp // num_query_groups_per_partition
                    for qkv_part_chunk in qkv_part.chunk(num_query_groups_per_partition):
                        q_part = qkv_part_chunk[:q_size_chunk]
                        k_part = qkv_part_chunk[q_size_chunk : q_size_chunk + kv_size_chunk]
                        v_part = qkv_part_chunk[q_size_chunk + kv_size_chunk :]
                        q_weight_list.append(q_part)
                        if i * config.num_key_value_heads % tp_size == 0:
                            k_weight_list.append(k_part)
                            v_weight_list.append(v_part)

        # -------------------

                    getattr(gpt_model_module.output_layer, "weight", None) if pp_rank == pp_size - 1 else None,

    if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:

            if dtype != v.dtype:
                state_dict[k] = v.to(dtype)

    print_rank_0(f"merge megatron ckpt done, time elapsed {time.time() - start_time}s")
    return state_dict

15	import os
16	import random
17	
18	import numpy as np
19	import torch
20	from tensordict import TensorDict
21	
22	from verl.utils import tensordict_utils as tu
23	from verl.utils.dataset.dataset_utils import DatasetPadMode
24	from verl.utils.device import is_npu_available
25	from verl.utils.device import manual_seed as device_manual_seed
26	from verl.utils.device import manual_seed_all as device_manual_seed_all
27	from verl.utils.py_functional import append_to_dict
28	from verl.utils.seqlen_balancing import rearrange_micro_batches, restore_dynamic_batch
29	
30	
31	def enable_full_determinism(seed: int):
32	    """
33	    Helper function for reproducibility in distributed training.
34	    See https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/notes/randomness.html for details.
35	    """
36	
37	    os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(seed)
38	    os.environ["CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"] = ":16:8"
39	    os.environ["FLASH_ATTENTION_DETERMINISTIC"] = "1"
40	    if is_npu_available:
41	        # The environment variable required to enable deterministic mode on Ascend NPUs.
42	        os.environ["HCCL_DETERMINISTIC"] = "true"
43	        os.environ["CLOSE_MATMUL_K_SHIFT"] = "1"
44	
45	    random.seed(seed)
46	    np.random.seed(seed)
47	    torch.manual_seed(seed)
48	    device_manual_seed(seed)
49	    device_manual_seed_all(seed)
50	    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True)
51	    # Enable CUDNN deterministic mode
52	    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
53	    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
54	    torch.backends.cudnn.enabled = False
55	
56	
57	def prepare_micro_batches(
58	    data: TensorDict,
59	    dp_group=None,
60	    num_batches_divided_by=None,
61	    same_micro_num_in_dp=True,
62	    min_num_micro_batch=None,
63	    use_dynamic_bsz_balance=True,
64	):
65	    """
66	    Prepare micro batches from data.
67	    """
68	    use_dynamic_bsz = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="use_dynamic_bsz", default=True)
69	    sp_size = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="sp_size", default=1)
70	
71	    force_group_size = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="force_group_size", default=1)
72	
73	    if use_dynamic_bsz:
74	        assert "max_token_len_per_gpu" in data.keys(), "max_token_len_per_gpu must be set when use_dynamic_bsz is True"
75	        max_token_len_per_gpu = data["max_token_len_per_gpu"]
76	        max_token_len = max_token_len_per_gpu * sp_size
77	        micro_batches, batch_idx_list = rearrange_micro_batches(
78	            data,
79	            max_token_len=max_token_len,
80	            dp_group=dp_group,
81	            num_batches_divided_by=num_batches_divided_by,
82	            same_micro_num_in_dp=same_micro_num_in_dp,
83	            min_num_micro_batch=min_num_micro_batch,
84	            use_dynamic_bsz_balance=use_dynamic_bsz_balance,
85	            force_group_size=force_group_size,
86	        )
87	    else:
88	        total_data_size = len(data)
89	        micro_batch_size_per_gpu = data["micro_batch_size_per_gpu"]
90	        assert total_data_size % (force_group_size * micro_batch_size_per_gpu) == 0, (
91	            "data size must be divisible by force_group_size * micro_batch_size_per_gpu"
92	        )
93	        micro_batches = tu.chunk_tensordict(data, total_data_size // (micro_batch_size_per_gpu * force_group_size))
94	        batch_idx_list = None
95	    return micro_batches, batch_idx_list
96	
97	
98	def postprocess_batch_func(output_lst, indices, data: TensorDict):
99	    """postprocess the output of a forward_backward_batch.
100	    output_lst is a list of dict containing outputs for each micro-batch
101	    reorder entropy and outputs. Return None for other pp ranks
102	    only on last rank. It should be on every tp rank
103	
104	    each losses_reduced contains 1. model_output, 2. loss, 3. metrics.
105	    """
106	
107	    use_dynamic_bsz = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="use_dynamic_bsz", default=True)
108	    pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="pad_mode", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)
109	    assert pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING, "postprocess_batch_func only support NO_PADDING pad_mode"
110	
111	    # losses_reduced is a list of dict containing outputs for each micro-batch
112	    # reorder entropy and outputs. Return None for other pp ranks
113	    # only on last rank. It should be on every tp rank
114	
115	    # losses_reduced contains 1. model_output, 2. loss, 3. metrics.
116	    # We perform reverse
117	
118	    model_output = {}
119	    losses = []
120	    aggregated_metrics = {}
121	
122	    # model output
123	    for o in output_lst:
124	        if "model_output" in o:
125	            for key, val in o["model_output"].items():
126	                if key not in model_output:
127	                    model_output[key] = []
128	                model_output[key].append(val)
129	
130	    # concat results from micro batches
131	    for key, val in model_output.items():
132	        if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:
133	            tensors = [tensor for nt in model_output[key] for tensor in nt.unbind()]
134	            model_output[key] = torch.nested.as_nested_tensor(tensors, layout=torch.jagged)
135	        else:
136	            raise NotImplementedError(f"pad_mode {pad_mode} not implemented")
137	
138	        # reverse with dynamic bsz
139	        if use_dynamic_bsz:
140	            model_output[key] = restore_dynamic_batch(model_output[key], indices)
141	
142	    # loss
143	    for o in output_lst:
144	        if "loss" in o:
145	            losses.append(o["loss"])
146	
147	    # metrics
148	    for o in output_lst:
149	        if "metrics" in o:
150	            metrics = o["metrics"]
151	            append_to_dict(aggregated_metrics, metrics)
152	
153	    output = {
154	        "model_output": model_output,
155	        "loss": losses,
156	        "metrics": aggregated_metrics,
157	    }
158	
159	    return output
